title: Senior Photo Editor (Architectural & Content)
description:
HIGH END, SENIOR PHOTO EDITORS ONLY - ARCHITECTURAL & CONTENT SPECIFIC

This is a unique photo editing opportunity and only the highest quality of photo editors, with the relevant experience and impressive portfolio need to apply. Excellent salary for the right candidate.





Clique Creative is South Australia's go-to for top-tier photography, videography, and marketing services. Our vision is to craft and inspire high-quality, consistent marketing solutions for property, people, and projects, while delivering a premium customer experience and fostering a fun, supportive workplace.



Clique Creative is on the hunt for a highly skilled Senior Photo Editor to join our growing creative team. If you've got a sharp eye for detail, expert-level Photoshop and Lightroom skills, and a passion for turning architectural, interior, and content photography into polished, high-impact imagery - we'd love to meet you.



In this role, you'll work across a broad and exciting range of photography, from structural and architectural shoots to interior design, new builds, headshots, and brand content. You'll collaborate closely with our Creative Director, Photography Coordinator, and photographers to deliver work that elevates our clients - property developers, architects, interior designers, and brands alike - and helps tell their story through standout visuals.



What You'll Do:

- Edit and retouch architectural, interior, new build, and content photography — including daylight and twilight/dusk imagery — to a high, vibrant, and visually appealing standard

- Remove imperfections, add lighting effects, and enhance image clarity across architectural, interior, and people-focused photography

- Remove unwanted objects or distractions for clean, polished final images

- Combine multiple exposures using flambient techniques for premium interior and architectural results

- Apply advanced editing techniques that enhance a property or space's appeal without compromising realism

- Use AI-assisted editing tools to boost efficiency and quality while keeping results natural and realistic

- Retouch people and headshot photography to a professional, polished finish

- Add virtual furniture and décor, or digitally declutter spaces, to help bring a finished space to life (a bonus skill, not essential)

- Keep your finger on the pulse of the latest editing software, techniques, and industry trends



Training & Mentoring New Editors

- Introduce new editors to our tools, editing style, and quality standards

- Run hands-on training sessions and share real examples of work that hits the mark

- Support new editors through their onboarding, providing feedback and guidance to help them thrive

- Help create and maintain training materials, guides, and checklists

- Partner with the Photography Coordinator to track progress and tailor ongoing development



About You

- 3+ years' experience in photo editing within architectural, interior, real estate, or content photography (or similar)

- Expert-level skills in Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom

- Confident with flambient blending, object removal, and sky replacement techniques

- Experience editing and retouching people and headshot photography

- A sharp eye for detail, composition, light, and colour — and a knack for natural, realistic edits

- Highly organised, deadline-driven, and comfortable managing multiple projects and high volumes of work

- Clear, professional and excellent English written communication

- Happy working independently as part of a distributed team

- Bonus points for experience training or mentoring other editors, familiarity with virtual staging, or a Cert IV/Diploma in Photography & Digital Imaging



The Details

Clique Creative is based in Adelaide, South Australia. This is a work-from-home role, so you'll need your own reliable computer and software setup - but your working hours will need to align with Adelaide time, 9am–5pm Monday to Friday (adjusting accordingly during daylight savings). We're after someone flexible and adaptable, ready to grow with us as our team and offering evolve.



Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you - apply today and help us create some of the best architectural and content imagery in the industry.

title: UGC Video Editor - Ecommerce
description:
Fill out form: (ADD PORFOLIO IN FORM, NO PORTFOLIO = APPLICATION NOT ACCEPTED)







UGC EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

AGENCY EXPERIENCE PREFERRED



About Us

We're a company running 7–8 figure DTC brand portfolios operating across the US, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our growth runs through paid social - Meta and TikTok at a serious scale, which means video is at the center of everything we do. We produce a high volume of UGC-style and direct-response ad creative, and we need editors who can keep up without the output quality slipping.



This isn't a passion project or a content agency. The videos we edit run as paid ads, and the numbers tell us immediately what's working and what isn't. If you're the kind of editor who gets better with every round of feedback and wants to understand why something performs, not just how it looks, this is the environment for you.

We operate across multiple brands and categories, which means if needed, our editors must have the ability to switch between brand voices and audience types without losing quality or pace.

 

The Role

You'll be editing video content primarily for paid social - UGC ads, direct-response creatives, product-focused content, AI visuals generation, and repurposed organic clips across Meta and TikTok. You'll work from briefs and raw footage provided by our creative strategists and UGC creators, and you'll be expected to turn around polished, platform-ready ads at a reliable pace.

This is a high-output, high-feedback role. You'll be part of a structured creative production workflow, briefs, revisions, performance reviews and the feedback you get will be based on how the content actually performs, not just how it looks.

 

What You'll Be Doing

Core Editing

•    Editing UGC-style and direct-response video ads from raw footage – fast edits [minimum 1.5sec-2 seconds frame changes on visuals], aggressive visuals, clean cuts when needed, strong pacing, and hooks that don't lose the viewer in the first three seconds

•    Applying motion graphics, captions, text overlays, sound design, and music to produce platform-ready content across Meta and TikTok

•    Working from creative briefs and script references you follow the direction but you also bring your eye to it

•    Producing multiple versions of the same concept (hook tests, CTA variations, format cuts) efficiently

Workflow & Collaboration

•    Receiving and interpreting briefs from creative strategists - asking smart questions upfront rather than going back and forth after the first cut

•    Submitting first cuts on time and responding to revision notes quickly and accurately

•    Staying current on UGC trends, editing styles, and platform-native formats and flagging when you see something worth testing

•    Keeping your project files, exports, and asset folders organized according to team SOPs

•    Supporting the team in repurposing high-performing content into new formats when needed

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

•    A strong portfolio of edited video ads -  UGC, direct-response, or DTC brand content; we want to see cuts that are designed to perform, not just look good

•    Proficiency in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut - you can work fast in whichever tool the project calls for

•    Strong sense of pacing - you know when a cut is too slow, when a hook is burying itself, and when to trim

•    Understanding of how paid social video works: hook structure, attention retention, CTA placement, and format differences between Meta and TikTok

•    Reliable output - you can handle multiple concurrent edits and hit deadlines consistently

•    Receptive to feedback, revision rounds are part of the job; taking notes personally isn't

Strong Advantages

•    Experience editing DTC, beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brand content

•    Motion graphics skills , text animations, transitions, lower thirds that go beyond basic templates

•    Experience with AI-assisted editing tools that improve turnaround without sacrificing quality

•    Understanding of what makes a winning ad not just technically clean editing, but structurally effective storytelling

•    Familiarity with the UGC content model and how to make creator footage feel polished without losing authenticity

Instant No's

•    Your portfolio is full of cinematic, long-form, or brand film content with no paid social or direct-response work we're not doing that here

•    You need heavy direction on every edit

•    You treat revision notes as optional suggestions - revisions exist to make the content perform better, and accuracy matters

•    You can't sustain output at volume - this is a high-output environment and pace is part of the job

 

What the First 90 Days Look Like

First 30 Days

•    Complete onboarding: brand immersion, SOP walkthrough, file structure orientation, and creative review process

•    Shadow existing edit requests to understand the standard we hold our output to

•    Begin editing live briefs and establish reliable turnaround time and revision accuracy from day one

60 Days

•    Editing independently with minimal back-and-forth, at this time, you've internalized the brief format and the quality bar

•    Operating at full output capacity across concurrent projects

90 Days

•    A trusted, high-output editor the team doesn't need to micromanage

•    Actively contributing to creative iteration and not just executing briefs but improving them

•    Clear track record of on-time delivery, accurate revisions, and consistent quality

•    Positioned for growth toward a Senior Editor role as the team scales

 

How We Measure Your Performance

•    Output volume - number of completed edits per week against targets

•    Revision rate - how many rounds does it take to get to final approval

•    Turnaround time - from brief receipt to first cut submission

•    Creative contribution - are you bringing ideas, flagging trends, and improving the briefs you receive

•    Ad performance - over time, do the edits you produce correlate with stronger results and are you getting winning ads

 

Compensation & Benefits

•    Competitive monthly rate (contractor) based on experience and portfolio quality

•    Clear growth path: Video Editor ? Senior Video Editor

•    Fully remote - no fixed location, flexible setup

•    Learning & development budget

•    Access to winning ad references and a structured feedback system that actually makes you better

•    Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production at real scale

•    Weekly performance reviews with the Creative Director

title: Brand & Content Strategist - Content Creator & Reels Editor (Social Media | Credit, Fitness & Motivation)
description:
WHO WE ARE



We are a growing personal brand built around three core pillars: credit repair and business funding, real estate acquisition, and an authentic lifestyle presence spanning fitness, renovations, and entrepreneurship. The brand is built around a real person with a real story — quiet, intentional, results-driven. The content needs to reflect that identity while commanding serious attention online.

THE ROLE



We are looking for a Brand and Content Strategist who does not wait to be told what to do. You understand how attention works online — not just what looks good, but what builds an audience, drives consistent visibility, and keeps potential clients thinking about this brand between posts. You think in campaigns, not content pieces. You think in growth, not output.



This is a gig and internship opportunity with a clearly defined path to a full-time salaried role at the six-month mark for the right person. If you are looking for a short-term freelance gig, this is not it. If you are looking to build something from the ground up alongside a founder who is serious about scaling — read on.



You will execute the content yourself while bringing the strategy that drives it. You are both the architect and the builder — for now.

- Real Estate & Renovations (primary)

- Fitness & Lifestyle

 & Trending Audio Content

WHAT YOU WILL OWN





BRAND STRATEGY & VISION AMPLIFICATION

- Collaborate directly with the founder to translate vision into a content system that keeps eyes on the brand consistently

- Develop monthly and quarterly content strategies tied to business goals — client acquisition, brand authority, and visibility

- Bring ideas, concepts, and creative directions to the table proactively — pitch before you are asked

- Identify what is performing in the credit repair, real estate, and entrepreneur niches and present actionable insights regularly




 INTELLIGENCE & TREND AWARENESS

- Know what is trending in US pop culture, finance, real estate, and short-form video before it peaks

- Adapt trending 
 formats, audio, and cultural 
nts to the brand's niche quickly and correctly

- Understand timing — a 
 posted three days late does not perform

- Bring the cultural intelligence yourself — we do not educate you on what is funny or what is trending



CONTENT STRATEGY & CALENDAR MANAGEMENT

- Build and manage a monthly content calendar across Instagram, YouTube,
, and TikTok

- Structure content by theme, funnel stage, and optimal posting time — not just by date

- Ensure every week has a clear content objective tied to visibility or conversion

- Track performance weekly and adjust strategy based on data



CONTENT EXECUTION — VIDEO, CAPTION & GRAPHIC

- Produce and deliver 3–7 high-quality Reels, Shorts, or TikTok-style edits per week

- Execute attention-grabbing hooks within the first 1–3 seconds — every time, no exceptions

- Write scroll-stopping captions — hooks, body copy, and CTAs that drive action

- Design carousels, branded 
 content, quote graphics, and educational visuals

- Repurpose long-form content into short, high-impact platform-native clips

- Design thumbnails, apply motion graphics, voiceovers, and text overlays as needed



PLATFORM MANAGEMENT & GROWTH TRACKING

- Schedule and publish content at algorithm-optimized times across all platforms

- Monitor engagement metrics and bring data-driven recommendations to leadership weekly

- Engage with comments and community to boost algorithmic reach

- Consistently add value — every week, every platform, no gaps, no excuses





WHAT YOU MUST BRING





STRATEGIC THINKING — Non-Negotiable

- You think about content as a system for audience growth and client acquisition — not a to-do list

- You can look at a brand and identify what is missing and what should be built next — without being asked

- You understand content funnels and build calendars with awareness, trust, and conversion in mind

- You have a point of view on what works and can defend it with data or platform knowledge



CAPTION WRITING & 
 INTELLIGENCE — Non-Negotiable

- Strong copywriting — captions that hook, hold, and convert

- Deep, current awareness of 
 culture, trending audio, and viral formats in US pop culture and niche communities

- You do not need to be told what is funny — you know, and you know how to apply it to a brand

- When something is trending, you pitch the adaptation before we ask



CONTENT EXECUTION — Elite Level Required

- Expert-level CapCut Pro — hooks, transitions, captions, audio sync, platform-optimized exports

- Additional tools a strong plus: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Canva Pro, InShot

- Proven track record of viral or high-performing Reels, Shorts, or TikToks — portfolio required, no exceptions

- Experience with carousels, 
 content, thumbnails, and educational graphics



NICHE KNOWLEDGE

- Working knowledge of credit repair — enough to create accurate educational content without hand-holding

- Familiarity with real estate, renovations, and entrepreneurship content and audiences

- Ability to match tone: high-energy for lifestyle, authoritative for credit repair and real estate education



CONSISTENCY & COMMUNICATION

- Consistent output of 3–7 pieces of content per week without dropping quality

- Experience building a brand presence from the ground up

- Proactive communicator — you surface ideas and flag issues without being chased

- Deadline-driven — on-time delivery is a baseline, not an achievement





THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- A strategic creative — thinks before they build, builds before they post

- Consumes short-form content daily and applies lessons without being prompted

- Can hold a creative conversation, push back when an idea is not strong, and bring alternatives

- Genuinely invested in building a brand long-term — not looking for a quick freelance paycheck

PLATFORMS & TOOLS



Required: CapCut Pro, Instagram/Reels, YouTube/Shorts,

Strong Plus: TikTok, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Canva Pro, Later/Buffer/Metricool, Meta Business Suite, ChatGPT/AI Tools, Google Drive





COMPENSATION & GROWTH PATH



Gig / Internship | Remote | $80/month USD | Path to Full-Time at 6 Months



This role starts as a gig and internship arrangement. At the six-month mark, the right candidate will be reviewed for a full-time position with a salary increase. This is a ground-floor opportunity — show up, perform at a high level, and grow with the brand long-term.





HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send a generic application — it will not receive a response.



In your application, include:

1. A portfolio or links to Reels, carousels, or content you have created — no portfolio means no consideration

2. Which content niche you have the most experience in and one specific result you drove

• Meets deadlines

• Communicate clearly

• Ability to learn and work independently

Pay:

ABOUT US:

Through social media, books, podcasts, articles, and other digital resources, we share practical and biblically grounded encouragement with people around the world. As our ministry grows, we're looking for someone who can become an important part of our long-term content team.





ABOUT THE POSITION

- This Is NOT a Traditional Virtual Assistant Role

WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH WEEK

For each topic, you'll create:



- One short-form Reel 
 / Instagram / TikTok)

- One social media post

- One Story sequence



After approval, you'll:



- Schedule content across our platforms

- Organize project files

- Update the content calendar

- Prepare a simple weekly analytics report



You'll also help us improve our content system over time by suggesting workflow improvements and using tools effectively.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

We're looking for someone who is comfortable using AI and modern content creation tools.

Preferred experience includes:



* ChatGPT

* Canva

* CapCut

* Google Drive

* Meta Business Suite

* TikTok Scheduler



Experience with Notion or Trello is a bonus.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who is:

* Creative

* Organized

* Reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable using AI

* Willing to learn

* Able to meet deadlines

* Open to feedback

* Interested in building long-term systems rather than simply completing tasks



REQUIRED SKILLS

* Excellent written English

* Canva

* CapCut

* Basic graphic design

* Short-form video editing

* Social media copywriting

* ChatGPT prompting

* Content organization



BONUS SKILLS

Experience creating content for:

* Christian ministries

* Coaches

* Authors

* Personal brands

* Relationship or mental wellness organizations



is an advantage but not required.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Every Friday, the following should be ready:



- 5 completed Reels

- 5 quote graphics

- 5 social media posts

- 5 Story sequences

- All content scheduled

- Organized project files

- Weekly analytics summary



As our systems improve, you'll also help us make our content production faster, smarter, and more efficient.



TRAINING & SUPPORT

You won't be starting from scratch.

We've already built detailed systems that you'll receive, including:



* Brand Guidelines

* Content Production SOPs

* Weekly Content Briefs

* AI Prompt Library

* Canva Templates

* CapCut Templates

* Content Calendar

* Workflow Documentation



Our goal is to help you succeed by providing clear systems and expectations.



COMPENSATION

* Part-time position

* Approximately 5–6 hours per week

* Competitive hourly rate based on experience



There is opportunity for increased hours and responsibility as the ministry grows.



OUR HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process is in the following states

Stage 1 – Application,

Stage 2 – Paid Practical Assignment and 

Stage 3 – Interview

Stage 4 – Paid Trial Week



Stage 1 – Application

Please submit:

1. Your resume.

2. A link to your portfolio or examples of your work.

Examples may include:

* Reels

* Short-form videos

* Canva graphics

* Social media pages you've managed



3. Briefly tell us about your experience using:

* ChatGPT

* Canva

* CapCut

*

* Instagram

* TikTok



4. In 200 words or less:

How has AI changed the way you create content?



Stage 2 – Paid Practical Assignment

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical assignment** based on a real content topic from our ministry. This assignment is designed to reflect the actual work involved in the role.

Selected candidates will be compensated for their time.



Stage 3 – Interview

Finalists will participate in a short interview to discuss:

* Communication

* Organization

* Workflow

* Long-term goals

* Cultural fit



Stage 4 – Paid Trial Week

The successful candidate will complete a paid trial week, working through our real content production process.

This gives both you and our team the opportunity to determine whether we're a good long-term fit for one another.



PLEASE INCLUDE THE PHRASE "HIRING DEPARTMENT" within the subject of your application.



Why Join Us?

This is more than a freelance content role. It's an opportunity to help build a ministry that brings hope, healing, and biblical encouragement to people navigating some of life's most difficult seasons. If you're excited about creating meaningful content, leveraging AI to work smarter, and growing with a mission-driven team, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Etsy Shop Manager
description:
We run 8 active Etsy shops and are looking for one reliable, detail-oriented person to take full ownership of the day-to-day. This is a real long-term role — not a trial gig. If you know Etsy inside and out and take pride in doing clean, consistent work, read on.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Upload new product listings with accurate titles, descriptions, tags, and attributes

- Research and apply Etsy SEO best practices to improve search ranking across all shops

- Monitor and respond to customer messages promptly and professionally

- Handle order issues, refunds, and disputes to maintain high review scores

- Track shop performance (views, favourites, conversion rate, revenue) and flag changes

- Keep listings up to date — pricing, photos, inventory counts, shipping details

- Conduct competitor and keyword research to find new opportunities

- Send a brief weekly update covering what was done, what's working, and any issues



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



- Proven Etsy shop experience (managing or selling)

- Strong understanding of Etsy SEO and the search algorithm

- Experience uploading and optimising listings at volume

- Good written English for customer communication

- Comfortable working independently without daily supervision

- Reliable internet connection and consistent availability

- Organised, with attention to detail on repetitive tasks

- Honest and communicates proactively when issues arise



BONUS EXPERIENCE (Nice to Have)



- Familiarity with eRank, Marmalead, or similar Etsy SEO tools

- Experience managing multiple shops simultaneously

- Basic Canva or photo editing skills for listing images

- Experience with Etsy Ads management



This is a fully remote, long-term position. We're not looking for someone to help out for a few weeks — we want to build a working relationship with someone who wants to grow with the business. As the shops grow, so does the opportunity.



PAY & HOURS



- $4–$7 per hour (USD)

- 40 hrs per week

- Monthly payment via Wise

- Rate based on experience — higher end for candidates with strong Etsy SEO track record

- Performance bonus available after 90-day probation period

- Paid Philippine public holidays after 3 months



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please send a message with the subject line "Etsy Manager Application" and include:



1. A brief intro about yourself and your Etsy experience

2. At least one example of an Etsy shop you've managed or worked on (shop name or screenshots are fine)

3. Your answer to this question: What's one thing most Etsy sellers get wrong with their SEO?



Applications without the question answered will not be reviewed. We read every message that follows the format.

title: Video Producer / Visual Content Creator for Online Rock Music Project
description:
I’m looking for a remote video producer to help create compelling visual content for an exciting new online Substack-based original music production project.



The project is in the early stages, so it offers great opportunities for additional responsibilities and wage increases for top performance as we grow.



You will collaborate closely with me to develop visual assets that bring original songs, livestreams, virtual concerts, and multimedia presentations to life through a combination of stock footage, AI-generated video, motion graphics, and creative visual storytelling.



The goal is to create engaging visual experiences for three things:

• Music videos for each of my original songs

• Visual backdrops for weekly music livestreams?

• Visual backdrops for virtual concert gigs at colleges, conferences, festivals, art house theaters, and other global venues?



The ideal candidate will be excited about helping build a unique music and multimedia brand by transforming original songs and livestream presentations into visually compelling experiences that attract, engage, and grow an audience.



==================================================

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

==================================================



• Music Video Production: Create a finished music video for each completed original song using a combination of royalty-free stock footage, AI-generated video, motion graphics, and other creative visual techniques. (I will provide examples for training purposes.) 

• Livestream Visual Asset Creation: Design and produce looping background visuals, scene assets, animated elements, intro sequences, transitions, and other visual components used in my Ecamm Live-created Sunday livestreams and virtual concert presentations. (I will provide examples for training purposes.)

• Visual Storytelling & Creative Direction: Collaborate with me to develop visual concepts that support the emotional themes, lyrical content, and storytelling of original songs.

• Footage Sourcing & Asset Management: Locate and organize high-quality royalty-free footage from platforms such as Artlist and other approved sources. (I will provide and pay for the Artlist subscription.)

• AI Video Production: Utilize AI video generation platforms to create custom visual assets and sequences that cannot easily be sourced through stock footage.

• Ongoing Strategy Sessions: Help brainstorm new visual approaches, workflows, and technologies that can improve production quality while maintaining an efficient and scalable content creation process.



==================================================

CORE TRAITS I’M LOOKING FOR: 

==================================================



• Creativity, initiative, and strong visual storytelling instincts

• Promptness, honesty, reliability

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with me on creative direction

• Curiosity and enthusiasm about emerging AI-powered creative tools

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Love of music, visual arts, filmmaking, or creative media is a major plus

• Experience editing and producing videos for YouTube, social media, livestreams, music artists, brands, or other creative projects

• Ability to combine stock footage, AI-generated footage, motion graphics, text overlays, and visual effects into polished finished productions

• Experience working with royalty-free footage libraries

• Strong sense of pacing, mood, composition, and visual storytelling

• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly

• Communicative: You're not afraid to give ideas, voice opinions and feedback, and ask the right questions when anything is unclear

• Reliable internet connection



==================================================

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAILY:

==================================================



You will work two hours a day, Monday through Friday. Each day you will work on one or more of the responsibilities listed above in the service of creating music videos, livestream visuals, virtual concert assets, and other multimedia content supporting audience growth and revenue generation.



Three times per week we’ll meet over Zoom for approximately one hour to review completed work, discuss upcoming projects, brainstorm creative ideas, and establish production priorities.



These Zoom sessions will likely be longer in the beginning as I train you on my music, creative vision, project history, and production goals, and shorter down the road as you become more familiar with the project and are able to take greater initiative.



==================================================

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: 

==================================================



• Get in at the ground level of a unique and innovative online original music venture

• A chance to help shape the visual identity and creative direction of a growing multimedia music project

• Hands-on experience working with both traditional video production and cutting-edge AI creative tools

• Long-term, stable remote work with the potential to expand scope and rate

• 2 hours a day, Monday – Friday (10 hours per week)

• Fully remote



==================================================

HOURS & COMPENSATION:

==================================================



• 2 hours a day, Monday - Friday (flexible, remote)

• Wage commensurate with experience



==================================================

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

==================================================



1)  Make your subject line: Super Rock Project Video Producer – [Your Name]

2)  Include a brief summary of your experience creating video content. 

3)  Include the types of projects you've worked on, industries served, software used, and your role in the production process.

4)  Include links to your portfolio, demo reel, YouTube channel, Vimeo page, or any examples of work that best represent your abilities.

5)  Tell me which video editing, motion graphics, AI video generation, and creative platforms you currently use and your level of experience with each.

6)  Tell me what excites you about the prospect of helping build an original music project through music videos, livestream visuals, and multimedia storytelling.

7)  Describe your current work commitments and how many hours per week you have available



I look forward to hearing from you. 



Rock on… because music matters.

title: Senior Magento 2 Full-Stack Developer

Develop, customize, and maintain Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) applications

Build and enhance both frontend and backend features

Develop custom modules, themes, and integrations

Apply patches, upgrades, and bug fixes

Optimize performance for large-scale product catalogs

Integrate Magento with external systems (APIs, ERP, third-party tools)

Troubleshoot and resolve issues in production environments

Collaborate with internal teams to improve workflows and user experience

5+ years experience as a Magento 2 Full-Stack Developer

Strong expertise in PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

Proven experience with Magento Enterprise (Adobe Commerce)

Magento (Adobe Commerce) certification

Experience with Adobe Commerce Cloud

Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms

Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows

What We Offer



100% Remote Work

Full-time position

Opportunity to work on high-scale e-commerce systems

Collaborative and fast-paced environment

Ideal Candidate



You are a hands-on Magento expert who:



Can confidently work across frontend and backend

Understands Magento deeply (not just surface-level customization)

Can handle complex data structures and integrations

Takes ownership of development and problem-solving

title: Business Development Manager South East ASIA
description:
About the Client



Novantar S.A. is the exclusive worldwide sales agent for Antarctica21, a pioneering Chilean operator of Antarctic expeditions and the world leader in Antarctic Air-Cruises. The Company’s adventure tours combine the comfort and speed of a flight to Antarctica with a boutique expedition cruise in a wilderness setting.



The Opportunity 



We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to join the Sales & Marketing team. The candidate must have at least three years of Business Development experience within the travel industry in South East ASIA ideally with a focus on the polar travel industry. He or she must have a keen desire to join a small, high-performing team that is passionate about delivering results.



The Role



The Business Development Manager, South East ASIA is responsible to generate revenue based on an annual sales plan from new clients and from an existing portfolio of travel agents and tour operators in the assigned markets. Through research, agent visits, product training sessions, and other promotional activities, the Business Development Manager ensures that assigned sales targets are met. He or she will encourage travel agents and tour operators to feature Antarctica21’s products prominently within their brochures, websites, and marketing activities.



Main responsibilities



Business Development Management



•        Research Travel Agents and Tour Operators in the assigned markets and profile potential new partners with audiences for the Company’s products.



•        Introduce the Company’s products to the prospective new partners and develop new business relationships in accordance with the Company’s annual sales plan.



•        Be intimately familiar with the product offers and marketing plan of the new partners to maximize the opportunities for exposure and revenue for Antarctica21. 



•        Support new partners with product training, marketing materials, and ideas for promotions to ensure that the Company’s products are featured accurately and in the best possible way.



•        Solicit, negotiate, and contract groups in the assigned markets.



 



 



Account Management



•        For each account in the assigned portfolio, build consensus and obtain commitment on annual passengers and productivity targets in accordance with the Company’s sales plan.



•        Review monthly revenue reports and hold regular productivity reviews with the assigned clients.



•        Gather intelligence about the assigned clients’ future plans with a view to shaping future offers and to maximize opportunities.



•        Ensure that the assigned accounts are kept up to date with changes in Antarctica21s product and offers.



Research, Planning, Analysis, and Administration



•        Assist the Commercial Director, in the production of annual sales plans for the South East ASIA market.



•        Using a monthly sales report by agent provided, maintain a monthly action plan.



•        Maintain an up-to-date summary of contact details for the key personnel at each account.



•        Maintain a summary of group and charter contracts.



•        Maintain a summary of special offers and conditions extended to assigned accounts.



•        Manage a business travel plan efficiently and within budget



•        Be intimately familiar with the offers of the competition.



•        Staying informed on the trends that shape the polar travel market and industry.



•        Carry out any other reasonable assignment that may assist in the smooth operation of the business.



 



Requirements





Minimum Required Skills and Knowledge



•        At least three years of business development experience within the travel industry in the South East ASIA, ideally with a focus on the polar travel industry.



•        A network of commercial relationships within the travel industry in the South East ASIA



•        A proven track record delivering assigned revenue targets.



•        Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with excellent command of the English Language.  



•        Experience with the consultative selling process, designing solutions for the mutual benefit of clients and the Company.



•        Familiarity with travel marketing channels and initiatives.



•        Persistence in the pursuit of objectives, with a demonstrated ability to take creative and pro-active actions to achieve goals.



•        Discipline, self-motivation, and proven experience working independently within set guidelines.



•        Proficiency with
, word processing, and spreadsheet applications.



•        Business travel experience.



•        Ability to accommodate frequent travel, including internationally.



 



 



Welcomed Additional Skills, Knowledge, and Experience



•        A university degree



•        Fluency in Spanish



•        Experience with high-end, active travel products



•        Demonstrated passion for nature, wildlife, photography, the arts, etc.



•        Knowledge of Antarctica, Chile, and Patagonia.

title: Top Vancouver Real Estate Team Hiring Experienced Virtual Transaction Coordinator Canadian Experience Required
description:
Experienced Virtual Transaction Coordinator for Top Vancouver Real Estate Team

Canadian Real Estate Experience Required



We are a top-producing real estate team based in Vancouver, BC, and we are looking for an exceptional Virtual Transaction Coordinator to join our team full-time.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who is highly organized, detail-driven, proactive, and confident managing real estate files from listing to closing. You will play a key role in keeping our transactions accurate, compliant, on schedule, and running smoothly so our agents can stay focused on serving clients and generating business.



We are not looking for a general virtual assistant.

We are looking for a true transaction coordinator who understands the pace, professionalism, and precision required in real estate.



Who This Role Is Perfect For



This role is ideal for someone who already has experience supporting a Canadian real estate team or brokerage and can step into the position with minimal hand-holding.



You take ownership.

You follow through.

You catch details others miss.

You communicate clearly and professionally.

You know how to keep files clean, timelines tight, and deals moving.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Coordinating real estate transactions from signed listing or accepted offer through completion



Preparing, organizing, and managing contracts, disclosures, and transaction documents



Ensuring files are complete, accurate, and compliant



Tracking key dates including deposits, subject removals, completion, possession, and other important deadlines



Communicating with agents, clients, lawyers, conveyancers, inspectors, and cooperating agents



Uploading, organizing, and maintaining documents in Skyslope, Google Drive, and related systems



Assisting with listing paperwork and MLS-related coordination



Scheduling inspections, appointments, and transaction-related follow-up



Following checklists and systems to ensure nothing falls through the cracks



Proactively flagging missing documents, deadlines, or issues before they become problems



Required Experience



Minimum 2 years of experience in real estate transaction coordination, real estate administration, or a similar role



Canadian real estate experience is required



Strong understanding of the Canadian real estate transaction process



Experience handling contracts, disclosures, compliance documents, and transaction timelines



Excellent written and spoken English



Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple files at once



High attention to detail and accuracy



Reliable internet connection and professional remote work setup



Available to work Monday to Friday during Vancouver business hours



Strong Preference Will Be Given To Candidates With



Experience supporting a BC real estate team or brokerage



Familiarity with BC real estate paperwork and timelines



Experience using Skyslope, Paragon, Touchbase, Follow Up Boss, Sisu, and Google Drive



Knowledge of the Vancouver real estate market



Compensation and Schedule



Full-time remote role



40 hours per week



Monday to Friday, aligned with Vancouver time



CAD $8 per hour



Long-term opportunity with room to grow for the right person



Why Join Our Team



You will be joining a top-producing Vancouver real estate team



You will be part of a fast-paced, professional, and growth-oriented environment



Your work will matter and be valued



We believe in strong systems, high standards, and long-term relationships



This is an opportunity for someone who wants stability, growth, and to be part of a winning team



How to Apply



Please use this subject line:



Rockstar TC for Vancouver, [Your Name]



Please include all of the following in your application:



Your resume



A short introduction about yourself



How many years of Canadian real estate experience you have



Which province you worked in



Which brokerage or real estate team you supported



Which real estate systems and tools you have used



A short example of one transaction you helped coordinate from contract to completion



Your availability in Vancouver time



Important



Please apply only if you have prior Canadian real estate transaction coordination or real estate administration experience.



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short skills test to evaluate transaction coordination, file organization, and deadline management.



We are looking for someone who is sharp, reliable, professional, and ready to become an important part of a high-performing team.



If that is you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Google Ads Specialist (International E-Commerce)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Google Ads specialist to help set up and manage campaigns for our premium durag and hair care brand, Oz Durag.



We currently operate a single Shopify store with multiple international domains:




 (International/US)


 (New Zealand)


 (Canada)


 (United Kingdom)



We need someone who understands international e-commerce advertising and can build a clear campaign structure for each market.



Responsibilities

Set up Google Ads campaigns for each domain and target market.

Create and structure Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns where appropriate.

Ensure each country targets the correct products, currencies, audiences, and landing pages.

Configure conversion tracking, GA4 integration, and enhanced conversions.

Set up audience segments, remarketing, and customer lists.

Optimise campaign structure to avoid overlap and competition between markets.

Provide ongoing management, reporting, and recommendations for scaling.

Requirements

Proven experience managing Google Ads for Shopify brands.

Experience running campaigns across multiple countries and domains.

Strong understanding of Google Merchant Center and product feeds.

Knowledge of international targeting, localisation, and attribution.

Ability to communicate clearly and explain strategy.

Experience with fashion, apparel, beauty, or e-commerce brands is highly preferred.

What We're Looking For



We want someone who can take ownership of the entire setup process and build a scalable foundation for long-term growth. The ideal candidate will recommend the best campaign structure rather than simply following instructions.



Please include:



Examples of Shopify stores you've worked with.

The countries/markets you've managed.

Monthly ad budgets you've handled.

Whether you offer ongoing management after setup.

Your preferred pricing structure (one-time setup fee, monthly retainer, or percentage of ad spend).



We are looking for a long-term relationship with the right person as we continue expanding into additional international markets.

title: Video Editor (Paid Ad Creatives)
description:
Hey there! We're Hest Enterprises — an eCommerce brand that is scaling globally.



We're looking for a Video Editor to join our fast growing team.



Your mission? Collaborate with our Creative Strategist & Copywriter to produce ad creatives that actually convert and help scale our brands to multiple 7 figures+.



Important! If you have zero interest in learning why ads work (not just making them look pretty), this role isn't for you. But if you're hungry to learn marketing while sharpening your editing skills...



Who We're Looking For



One golden rule at our company: you must have the DESIRE to learn & grow. If you're not passionate about getting better every week, this isn't the place for you.



The purpose of this role isn't just editing videos — it's learning how to edit for performance. You'll learn how hooks grab attention, how emotional pacing drives watch time, and how the right angle maximizes ROAS. We'll train you on the marketing side — you bring the hunger.



You're a great fit if you:



- Love editing videos and want to get seriously good at it

- Are curious about what makes ads actually convert

- Take feedback well and move fast on revisions

- Are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

- Want to grow into a Creative Strategist role over time (not necessary)



What You'll Do Day-to-Day



- Edit short-form video ads (UGC, product clips, b-roll)

- Assemble ads using provided scripts, briefs, and reference examples

- Add text overlays, captions, cuts, and pacing optimized for ads

- Create variations from the same core footage for testing

- Help document ad structure in simple briefs (hook, message, CTA)

- Make revisions based on internal feedback

- Keep files and exports organized for the team

- Attend weekly learning check-ins



Required:



- Experience with Video Editing ads (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar)

- Clear written English

- Ability to follow instructions and hit deadlines

- Open & Curious to Feedback and Revisions

- Organised and reliable



Why Join Us?



- Bonuses & Profit Share — You'll earn bonuses tied to the performance of ads you help create. When your work converts, you get rewarded.

- Real Training — Not just video editing. We'll train you on ad structures, creative strategy, and how to edit for results. You'll learn marketing fundamentals most junior editors never get exposed to.

- Growth Path — There's a clear path from Junior Editor ? Creative Strategist based on performance. We promote from within.



How Does This Work?



We hold our team to high standards and reward great work — expect your rates to grow as you do. Here's our simple hiring process:



- Send a short intro video about yourself and your experience,

- A portfolio or samples of video edits (ads preferred)

- Culture and Values Interview

- Complete a quick editing assessment tailored for the role

- Final interview with our Founder to discuss fit and finalize an offer



If this resonates with you, let's chat! Choose the number of the core value you feel aligns with you most and include it in your application:



1 - RESULTS OBSESSED

2 - ATTENTION TO DETAIL

3 - ACCELERATED EXCELLENCE

4 - RELENTLESS OWNERSHIP

5 - PREPARED TO WIN

6 - COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION

7 - NEVER NOT GROWING



Apply now and let's grow together!

title: Remote Home Care/Healthcare Recruiter
description:
IMPORTANT: We don't review applications on this platform. We use OLJ for job posting ONLY. If you want to be invited for an interview, directly APPLY on our page: 





About Us



At Helper Heroes, we’re on a mission to provide exceptional care and support to home care agencies in America. We believe in creating a true partnership where our employees act and feel like a true member of the American team they are matched with. Our goal is to help them create a compassionate, innovative, and efficient care experience for their clients and their families. To achieve this, we’re looking for a Helper Hero to join our team and help us shine even brighter!



About You



What sets us apart is YOU. You’re not just any virtual tea
mber—you’re a Helper Hero! If you’re passionate about making a difference, have a knack for organization, and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, you’re who we are looking for. If you’re the kind of person who loves tackling behind-the-scenes tasks with a smile, ensuring that our clients' caregivers and clients receive the best possible support, apply today!



Job Overview



We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Recruiter to support recruitment, caregiver

onboarding, and administrative tasks for a growing home care business. This role is

ideal for someone with experience in healthcare recruitment and a passion for

streamlining operations. You will work closely with the owner to alleviate their workload,

enabling them to focus on business growth and client care.



Key Responsibilities



1. Recruitment & Onboarding:



- Manage end-to-end caregiver recruitment: screen applicants, schedule interviews, and coordinate orientation/training.

- Process onboarding documentation via ADP Workforce (e.g., electronic I-9s, employee handbook distribution).

- Track and ensure completion of state-mandated caregiver training (e.g.,via Active Insights).



2. Administrative Support



- Answer inbound calls during peak hours and manage voi
s/lead inquiries.

- Assist with client intake calls and referral source coordination.

- Provide general administrative support (e.g., scheduling, data entry).



3. Systems & Collaboration



- Utilize platforms like WellSky or Axiscare (training provided) to streamline workflows.

- Collaborate with the owner to refine processes and maintain organization.



Qualifications:



- Excellent written/verbal communication (fluent English).

- Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

- Proficiency with CRM systems,
 management, and cloud-based tools (e.g., Google Drive).

- Proactive mindset—anticipate needs before they arise.

- Proven experience in recruitment, specifically in healthcare or home care staffing.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and tea
mbers.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Customer Support Specialist

(Remote — Philippines-based)

Hours: 6:30am – 3:00pm AEST (daylight savings may apply)

About MachShip

MachShip is a fast-growing, cloud-based freight management platform that simplifies logistics for businesses across Australia. We connect shippers with carriers, streamline freight workflows, and help our customers take the complexity out of moving goods. Our team is collaborative, curious, and genuinely invested in the customer experience — and we're looking for someone who shares that energy.



About the Role

As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for MachShip customers — responding to enquiries, diagnosing issues, and delivering fast, accurate, and empathetic support across our channels. This is a hands-on role where you'll develop deep platform knowledge, contribute to our knowledge base, and work closely with a high-performing support team.



You'll thrive here if you take genuine ownership of your work, communicate clearly under pressure, and approach every problem with curiosity and method. We use AI tools to work smarter, but your understanding always comes first.



What You'll Be Doing

• Responding to customer enquiries across
 and support channels in a timely, professional manner

• Accurately diagnosing and resolving common issues using documented processes, product knowledge, and available tools

• Escalating complex issues to Senior Specialists or Team Leaders with clear, detailed case notes — never passing on a ticket without full context

• Managing your personal ticket queue to SLA requirements, owning each ticket from open to resolution

• Building and maintaining product knowledge through onboarding, training, and self-directed learning

• Contributing to knowledge base articles by flagging gaps and suggesting improvements based on what you observe

• Documenting cases accurately and thoroughly in the ticketing system

• Using AI tools to draft, research, and improve quality — while always verifying content before it reaches a customer

• Participating in tea
etings, stand-ups, and quality review processes



What We're Looking For

Essential

• 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing support or technical support role

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — clear, professional, and empathetic

• Proactive by nature — you identify what needs doing and act on it without being asked

• Exceptional problem-solving skills — methodical, logical, and accurate under pressure

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in all written communications and case notes

• Ability to manage a busy ticket queue and prioritise effectively

• Comfortable learning and working across new software platforms (Zoho Desk, Zendesk, Jira or similar)

• Calm and composed when handling challenging or frustrated customer interactions

• Honest about knowledge limits — you know when to escalate, and you do it well



Desirable

• Experience in a SaaS or technology environment

• Exposure to logistics, freight, or supply chain platforms (e.g. Sendle, Transvirtual, Toll, Shipit)

• Familiarity with SLA-based ticketing systems and CRM platforms

• Tertiary qualification in IT, Business, Communications, or a related field



The Person We're Looking For

You communicate exceptionally well — whether it's a technical explanation, a difficult update to a frustrated customer, or a well-written case note that someone else can pick up instantly. You take initiative without waiting to be directed, and when something doesn't go to plan, your first instinct is to understand why and fix it properly.



You're curious about how things work and motivated to grow your technical knowledge over time. You understand that accuracy matters — and that a well-escalated ticket is always better than a rushed resolution. You're a team player who contributes beyond your own queue.



Hours: 6:30am – 3:00pm AEST, aligned with Australian business hours. Daylight savings may apply.

Please note: Skills testing will form part of the recruitment process for this role.



Our Values

• Delight Our Customers — everything we do shapes their experience

• Sweat the Small Stuff — progress comes from doing the details well

• One Team — we're all on the same side, solving shared problems

• Challenge With Curiosity — better outcomes come from good questions and respectful debate

• Go Hard or Go Home — we offer flexibility and trust, and expect energy, integrity, and ownership in return



How to Apply

If this sounds like the role for you, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your resume highlighting your relevant skills and experience.



You can either attach your resume directly, or include your full professional details — including your work history, key skills, achievements, and contact information — in your application for consideration. Applications without relevant experience or supporting detail may not progress.



We review applications as they come in, so don't wait — apply now.

title: Meta Ads VSL Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

• VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

• DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

• Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

• Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

• Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

• Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

• Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

• Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

• Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

• Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

• Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

• Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

• Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

• Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

• Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

• Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

• Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

• Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.



ENGAGEMENT DETAILS:

Schedule Flexible / output-based — strict deadlines apply

Onboarding Paid trial project before transitioning to ongoing engagement



To Apply:

If you are an exceptional designer with a portfolio that demonstrates world-class DTC brand quality, kindly fill out the application form:






Looking forward to receiving your application!

title: Medical Billing & Coding Specialist – Pain Management / eCW / Denials – Full-Time
description:
**Medical Billing & Coding Specialist – Pain Management / eCW / Denials – Full-Time**



We are a U.S.-based interventional pain management medical clinic looking for a reliable, experienced **Medical Billing & Coding Specialist** to join our team full-time.



This is a long-term role for someone who understands U.S. medical billing, denials, payer follow-up, corrected claims, EOB review, and coding issues. This is not a general virtual assistant position.



The role is approximately:



**70% billing, denials, AR follow-up, and payer communication**

**30% coding review and claim accuracy support**



Our top priorities are:



1. Prevent coding and modifier mistakes before claims go out.

2. Work old AR, denials, EOBs, corrected claims, payer calls, and appeal preparation.



**About our clinic**



We are a U.S. pain management practice. We perform interventional pain procedures, office visits, medication management, injections, fluoroscopy-guided procedures, ultrasound-guided procedures, and other specialty services. We need someone who can help us improve billing accuracy, reduce denials, and follow through on claims until they are paid or properly resolved.



**Required experience**



You must have experience with U.S. medical billing.



Strongly preferred:



* Pain management billing or coding experience

* Orthopedic, spine, anesthesia, PM&R, surgery center, or specialty billing experience

* eClinicalWorks experience

* Denial management experience

* Corrected claims experience

* Payer portal experience

* EOB/ERA review experience

* Insurance phone call experience



Certification is preferred but not required.



Preferred certifications include CPC, COC, CCS-P, CCS, RHIT, RHIA, or similar U.S. medical coding certification. However, real-world U.S. pain management billing/coding experience is more important than certification alone.



**Responsibilities**



You will help with:



* Reviewing claims before submission for obvious coding, modifier, or documentation issues

* Working old AR

* Reviewing EOBs and denial reasons

* Calling payers and documenting call reference numbers

* Checking payer portals

* Preparing corrected claims

* Preparing appeal/reconsideration notes

* Identifying repeat denial patterns

* Escalating coding or documentation problems before claims are sent

* Working with our biller and physician on difficult claims

* Helping create internal billing/coding notes and cheat sheets

* Making sure claims are not written off incorrectly without review



**Examples of areas we work with**



Pain management and specialty coding may include office visits, injections, epidurals, medial branch blocks, radiofrequency ablation, SI joint procedures, genicular procedures, trigger point injections, joint injections, fluoroscopy, ultrasound guidance, sedation, urine drug testing, J-codes, modifiers, bundled codes, and payer-specific denial rules.



You do not need to know everything on day one, but you must have strong U.S. billing fundamentals and be able to learn quickly.



**Schedule**



This is a full-time position.



You must be available live during U.S. Central Time business hours.



You must be responsive during scheduled work hours through our communication system.



**Pay**



$8–$12 USD per hour depending on experience, skill level, eCW experience, pain management experience, and reliability.



**Important: No overemployment**



We are looking for someone who is dedicated and reliable.



During your scheduled work hours, you must work only for our clinic. You may not work another job, take other client calls, perform tasks for another employer, outsource your work, share your login, or allow anyone else to access our systems.



This role requires real-time availability, responsiveness, accurate time tracking, and professional accountability.



If you are currently working another full-time U.S. shift job, please do not apply unless you are leaving that job before starting with us.



**Confidentiality and HIPAA**



This is a medical practice. You will be working with confidential healthcare information.



You must sign confidentiality/HIPAA documents. You must not save patient information locally, send patient information through personal
, share screenshots, share passwords, use unauthorized devices, or discuss patient information outside approved systems.



**Requirements**



* Reliable computer

* Fast stable internet

* Backup internet preferred

* Quiet work environment

* Strong written English

* Comfortable making payer phone calls

* Detail-oriented

* Honest and reliable

* Able to follow instructions

* Able to document work clearly

* Able to work full-time U.S. Central Time hours



**How to apply**



Use this subject line:



**Pain Billing Coding Specialist – No OE – [Your Name]**



In your application, answer these questions:



1. How many years of U.S. medical billing experience do you have?

2. Have you worked in pain management, orthopedics, spine, anesthesia, PM&R, surgery center, or another specialty? Explain.

3. Have you used eClinicalWorks? If yes, what billing tasks did you perform in eCW?

4. What payer portals have you used?

5. Are you comfortable calling insurance companies and documenting call reference numbers?

6. What types of denials have you handled?

7. What coding certifications do you have, if any?

8. Are you currently working another job during U.S. business hours?

9. Are you able to work full-time live U.S. Central Time hours?

10. Why are you interested in a long-term full-time role with our clinic?



Applications that do not answer these questions may not be reviewed.

What You’ll Do

- Design and improve e-commerce shops, landing pages, and other marketing interfaces.

- Good eye for layout, typography, spacing, and overall design.

title: Business Development Specialist (Part-Time | Remote)
description:
## Applications close July 7, 2026



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 20 hours per week (Night Shift – U.S. Central Time)



## About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based copier and printer rental company serving businesses and apartment communities throughout the Houston, Texas area.



We provide businesses with flat-rate copier rental solutions that include equipment, toner, maintenance, and service. Our mission is to make office printing simple, reliable, and hassle-free while delivering exceptional customer service.

---



## Before You Apply



Please answer the following questions with your application. Incomplete applications may not be considered.



1. Tell us about your B2B sales experience. What products or services have you sold?

2. Describe your biggest sales achievement.

3. What sales and CRM tools have you used? (Apollo, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ChatGPT, etc.)

4. Are you available to work Monday–Friday during U.S. Central Time business hours (night shift in the Philippines)?

5. Please write a short
 (150 words or less) introducing our copier rental service to a business customer.

6. Please include a 1–2 minute video introduction explaining why you are the right fit for this position.



**To confirm you have read this posting, please begin your cover letter with the words: "Houston Growth."**



---



## Responsibilities



* Research and identify prospective customers.

* Build and maintain prospect lists.

* Conduct outbound cold calls to businesses and apartment communities.

* Send personalized
 outreach and follow-up communications.

* Qualify leads and identify customer needs.

* Prepare quotations and rental agreements.

* Close new customer accounts.

* Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activities.

* Work closely with our operations team to ensure a smooth customer handoff.

* Meet weekly activity and sales goals.



---



## Qualifications



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Previous B2B sales or business development experience.

* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

* Comfortable making outbound sales calls.

* Organized, self-motivated, and dependable.

* Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office.



**Preferred:**



* Experience selling to businesses in the United States.

* Experience using CRM systems.

* Experience with sales prospecting tools such as Apollo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.



---



## Compensation



* **USD $350–500 per month** (based on experience)

* Performance-based incentives for achieving sales goals and closing new customer accounts.

* This position is initially part-time (20 hours/week). As the company grows and based on performance, there is an opportunity to transition into a full-time position with increased responsibilities and compensation.

* Long-term career growth opportunities.





## Why Join Us?



* Work directly with the founder of a growing U.S. company.

* Make a measurable impact on business growth.

* Long-term opportunity with room to grow.

* Supportive and collaborative work environment.

* Learn modern sales tools and best practices.

* Performance is recognized and rewarded.



If you're motivated by achieving results, enjoy speaking with customers, and want to grow with a U.S. company, we'd love to hear from you. Apply before July 7, 2026.

title: Email List Manager (GoHighLevel. Part-Time, Remote)
description:
We're a fast-moving health and wellness marketing team and looking for someone for one specific role here! 



We're looking for a GoHighLevel
 Manager who is detail-obsessed, constantly online, and takes mission-critical accuracy personally. This is a small but super important /mission-critical role! Mistakes here have consequences when we're sending an
 to thousands of people so "Wrong subject lines, wrong segments, wrong send times, major typos, and broken links" are not acceptable. 



We need someone who triple-checks everything before confirming, and then checks again.



It's a very simple but very critical piece here. This is a part-time role with a need for high availability. Expected response time during your work hours: within 1-2 hours max. When an
 is approved, we usually need it loaded same-day.



Requirements:

- 1-2 years+
 list management experience (Activecampaign, Klaviyo, mailgun, convertkit, etc).

- 1-2 years+ Experience with GHL CRM (You are a GHL Expert!)

- Fast responder! This is a fast responder role where things need to be loaded in fairly immediately before certain schedule deadlines. You will have to be able to respond quickly within hours before certain
s are sent! 

- Extremely detail oriented. We want someone who triple-checks the segment, the subject line, the preview text, the send time, and the from-name before hitting schedule.

- Triple check to make sure there are no spelling or grammar mistakes that are glaringly obvious (we will sometimes send INTENTIONAL spelling/ grammar mistakes based on what we're saying)

- Have a Grammarly account or some type of spell-checking software

- Have experience with GHL Smart Lists, Workflows, and the
 platform itself for one-off campaigns

- Organization capabilities within GHL





Bonus:

- You also have page design skills.

- You are GHL certified/ work directly within GHL

- If you have a personal interest and love for all things health, detoxification, spirituality, holistic healing, and you are health-conscious yourself

- Background in
 marketing or working with online coaches and creators (NOT e-commerce!)



What you'll be doing:



- Upload the
 into Go High Level from a Google Doc

- Formatting copy within the
 designer of Go High Level (we have a simple template we need followed for each
)

- Triple check to make sure the segment is sending to the right person

- Reply to messages within hours!

- Looking over the
 for any obvious spelling or grammar issues before it goes out

- Flagging anything that looks off and confirming with us before changing it. Some typos/grammar choices in our copy are intentional style choices, so always ask first.

- Excellent written English. You don't have to be a writer, but you should be able to spot when a sentence is genuinely broken vs. just stylistic.

- We will need you to be sending each
 with the proper UTM tracking links too.



This can evolve to a full time role here where this is the main thing you're doing.



Compensation: 

$100-$300/month

title: Takeoff Estimator — HVAC / Refrigeration
description:
RFTN Refrigeration & HVAC — a Sydney air conditioning, refrigeration and ventilation business (commercial and residential), 30+ years in the trade. We need someone to help our internal estimating team with quantity takeoffs. That's the job: takeoffs off our drawings, clean and accurate.



What you'll do

- Quantity takeoffs fro
chanical / HVAC drawings:

  - Refrigerant + refrigeration pipework (copper runs + insulation)

  - Sheet metal ductwork — supply / return / exhaust, main runs + fittings

  - Ventilation + exhaust systems (fans, fresh-air)

  - Grilles, diffusers, equipment + plant counts (FCUs, condensers, AHUs)

- Measure off the drawings and return clean, organised Excel takeoffs / material lists.

- Metric (Australian drawings).



Must have

- Reads mechanical / HVAC drawings confidently. Metric (m, m², kg).

- Takeoff experience — HVAC/mechanical ideal, or strong general construction takeoff.

- Bluebeam or PlanSwift + Excel.

- Good written English. Accurate over fast.



Nice to have

- HVAC estimating software (Trimble AutoBid, FastDUCT/FastPIPE, MagiCAD).

- Mechanical / refrigeration trade knowledge.



Pay

Paid per project. Starts with a paid trial (one takeoff). Ongoing work for the right person.



How to apply — read carefully (I skip anyone who doesn't)

1. Start your message with the word DUCT.

2. In 3–4 lines: the biggest HVAC/mechanical job you've taken off, and what you measured.

3. Attach one takeoff or sample of your work.

description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Civil / Industrial CAD Draftsperson to prepare a professional Site Layout Plan for an industrial waste recycling facility located in Western Australia.



This is a one-time project with the possibility of future drafting work.



Scope of Work



You will be provided with:



Existing building floor plan (PDF)

Equipment layout and dimensions

Site photographs

Layout mark-ups and detailed instructions



Your responsibilities include:



Convert the existing PDF into a clean and editable AutoCAD (DWG) drawing.

Prepare a professional Site Layout Plan suitable for submission to a government authority.

Produce a clear, accurate and well-presented drawing using Australian drafting standards.

Add all required dimensions, labels, legends, north point and title block.

Clearly identify:

Building layout

Equipment locations

Waste receiving area

Waste sorting area

Temporary material holding areas

Hook Lift Truck movement path

Forklift and Bobcat operating routes

Emergency exits

Fire extinguishers and emergency equipment

Safety signage and operational zones

Deliverables

Editable AutoCAD DWG

PDF Drawing (High Resolution)

Requirements



Applicants must have:



Minimum 5 years' experience in AutoCAD drafting.

Previous experience preparing Industrial Site Layout Plans, Civil Site Plans or Factory/Warehouse Layouts.

Strong understanding of professional drafting standards.

Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to communicate in English.

Ability to complete the project within the agreed timeframe.

Experience with one or more of the following:



Waste Management Facilities

Recycling Facilities

Material Recovery Facilities (MRF)

Transfer Stations

Industrial Warehouses

Manufacturing Plants

Civil Infrastructure Projects

Application Requirements
