Your estimated completion time.

Your fixed project price.



Applications without a portfolio or relevant drawing samples will not be considered.



Preference will be given to applicants with previous experience preparing drawings for Australian projects or Australian engineering consultants.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for Social Media Ads
description:
We are hiring a new batch of **Video Editors** to help create high-quality video ads for social media.



This role is mainly for video editing, but we prefer someone who also understands basic graphic design or can help with static ad creatives when needed.



This is a full-time role for someone who wants stable long-term work, consistent growth, and the chance to improve inside a strong creative team.



We are looking for people who are serious, reliable, coachable, and able to follow instructions carefully.



## Role Details



Position: Video Editor

Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

Days Off: Saturday and Sunday



Starting Pay: $600–$800/month depending on skill, experience, and fit

Regular Salary: Up to $1,000/month after passing evaluation



Strong performers may be reviewed earlier for faster progression.



## What You’ll Work On



You will help create:



* Short-form video ads

* Social media video creatives

* Direct-response ad creatives

* AI-assisted video assets when needed

* Basic static graphic ads when needed



## What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Has strong video editing skills

* Has experience creating ads, social media creatives, or short-form content

* Understands hooks, pacing, captions, messaging, sound design, and visual storytelling

* Has basic graphic design knowledge or can create simple static ad creatives

* Can follow instructions carefully

* Communicates clearly during working hours

* Is open to feedback and revisions

* Wants long-term full-time work

* Is comfortable using or learning AI creative tools



Important: All work must be completed by the person hired. Outsourcing, subcontracting, or passing work to someone else is not allowed and is grounds for termination.



## Hiring Process



1. Submit your application

2. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to confirm role expectations

3. Qualified applicants will move to interview or skills assessment

4. Selected applicants will receive an offer



## How to Apply



To show that you read the post, include the name of your FAVORITE MOVIE in the headline/title of your application.



Example:

AVENGERS - Your Name



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Tell us about your video editing experience and whether you can also create basic graphic/static ads

3. Exactly 3 links to your best ad-related video work

4. The tools/software you use for video editing, graphics, and AI creative work

5. Confirm that you can work full-time, Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

6. In 2–3 sentences, explain why you are looking for a long-term full-time role



Please write using your own words. Do not send a generic AI-written or copy-paste application.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.



If you are serious about video editing, hungry to improve, and ready for a full-time role with a growing creative team, we’d like to hear from you.

 us

title: Financial Controller
description:
About the Role



We are a U.S.-based healthcare services company looking for a hands-on Controller to own our accounting close and financial reporting, bring our books to a state we can rely on, and lead a small, capable remote finance and operations team.



Today, most of our day-to-day operations run through an interconnected set of Google Sheets, while financial transactions are recorded in QuickBooks Online. We want a controller who can make QuickBooks the source of truth for financial reporting—producing an accurate P&L and balance sheet every month—while keeping our Google Sheets running smoothly as operational tools.



This is a role for someone who is both a strong accountant and a capable manager: comfortable making categorization and accounting judgment calls independently, and equally comfortable directing, reviewing, and developing a team.





Key Responsibilities



Accounting & Monthly Close





Own the monthly close and produce timely, accurate financial statements (P&L and balance sheet) in QuickBooks Online.

Establish and maintain QuickBooks as the company's financial source of truth, with Google Sheets used operationally.

Maintain the chart of accounts, class structure, and cost-of-goods-sold framework; make and document categorization decisions independently rather than escalating routine ones.

Prepare and post journal entries, including payroll allocations and owner draws/distributions.

Reconcile all funding channels: bank deposits, merchant processors, financing partners, ACH, and checks.





Cash Flow & Payroll





Prepare the weekly cash-flow forecast every Wednesday by 8:00 AM, covering transacted-but-undeposited revenue across all channels and upcoming obligations (payroll, vendors, financing).

Prepare and review weekly payroll for submission to our payroll processor. Final sign-off remains with ownership; you ensure it is accurate and ready.

Track commissions, bonuses, reserves, deferrals, and clawbacks accurately and transparently.





Expense Management & Internal Controls





Review corporate card activity against receipts and policy; flag personal or unapproved charges and manage clawbacks.

Build and enforce expense and card-usage policies, including documentation and approval standards.

Track refunds and chargebacks; put controls in place to prevent duplicate or erroneous refunds.

Oversee accounts receivable and collections, including payment follow-ups and tracking of uncollected sales.





Systems & Data Integrity





Maintain and safeguard our Google Sheets architecture (rep workbooks, master sales sheet, weekly P&L/payroll, cash-flow analysis, bonus and scoring trackers), including formula integrity, cross-sheet links, and range protection.

Standardize recurring processes and document clear SOPs.

Help evaluate and, where feasible, support a future migration of recordkeeping toward more integrated tooling or a CRM.





Team Leadership





Manage, direct, and develop a three-person remote finance/operations team.

Assign and prioritize work, review deliverables for accuracy and completeness, and ensure deadlines are met.

Establish and monitor productivity and time-tracking standards; hold the team accountable for both hours worked and output delivered.

Serve as the first point of resolution for day-to-day questions, reducing escalations to ownership.





Reporting & Stakeholders





Produce financial reports for ownership and, when needed, for prospective partners or lenders.

Communicate proactively and clearly in writing, primarily via Slack and
.







What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)





QuickBooks cleaned up to the point of producing an accurate P&L and balance sheet.

Reliable weekly cash-flow forecast and payroll, with minimal ownership involvement in routine categorization.

A documented categorization ruleset and a basic internal-controls/expense-policy framework.

A clear, accurate handle on team workload, output quality, and hours.







Required Qualifications





5+ years of progressive accounting/bookkeeping experience, including ownership of a monthly close.

Advanced QuickBooks Online skills (chart of accounts, classes, journal entries, COGS).

Strong Google Sheets ability: complex formulas (e.g., QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA) and the ability to debug and maintain a system of linked workbooks.

Demonstrated experience managing a team (remote experience preferred).

Excellent written English and a schedule with significant overlap with U.S. business hours.

High integrity, strong attention to detail, and a proactive, ownership mindset.





Preferred (Nice to Have)





CPA (Philippine CPA) or equivalent credential.

U.S. GAAP familiarity (accrual accounting, contra-revenue, COGS treatment).

Experience with payroll processors (e.g., ADP), AP/AR and ACH platforms (e.g., 
), corporate card platforms (e.g., Divvy, Amex), and merchant/financing processors.

Experience evaluating or implementing a CRM (e.g., GoHighLevel).







Tools You'll Use



QuickBooks Online · Google Sheets · ADP · 
 · Divvy · Amex · Care Credit/Synchrony · Chase Payment Solutions · Wise · Slack





Reporting & Authority





Reports directly to ownership.

Manages the three-person finance/operations team.

Prepares and reviews payroll; final payroll sign-off and all expenditure approvals remain with ownership.

title: Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator
description:
We are a U.S.-based private money lending company that provides short-term, asset-based loans to real estate investors. We focus on first- and second-position loans, bridge funding, gap funding, and creative real estate transactions.

We value clean execution, capital protection, and professional communication.



Role Overview

We are hiring a Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator to run borrower intake, manage our loan pipeline, and prepare deal files for underwriting. This role is the operational backbone of our lending business and works directly with borrowers, brokers, and internal leadership.



This is not a bank mortgage role. You will support private money and creative real estate deals using a CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel) and documented internal SOPs.



Key Responsibilities



Borrower Intake & Pipeline Management

Respond to new borrower applications and CRM inquiries the same business day

Send first-touch outreach to all new borrower leads promptly

Follow up consistently to collect missing application items

Accurately track and update borrower status through the correct CRM pipeline stages

Keep the pipeline clean — no stale files, no unanswered leads

Flag urgent or high-priority deals for leadership without delay





Loan File Organization & Documentation

Create and maintain borrower folders in Google Drive per company naming conventions

Collect ALL required documents before escalating a file: purchase agreement, rehab budget/scope of work, ARV comps, property photos, borrower ID, LLC documents (Operating Agreement + proof of good standing), verified HUDs, insurance, and a clearly stated exit strategy

Track all documents and file status accurately in the CRM

Submit complete, clearly labeled files that are ready for underwriting





SOP Adherence & Deal Pre-Qualification

Pre-qualify deals against our lending criteria before escalating (private money vs. hard money vs. hybrid)

Apply our quick-screen criteria accurately (LTV, borrower spread, combined leverage, close timeline)

Verify all non-negotiable borrower requirements

Route deals that fall outside our criteria to our referral process per SOP

Escalate unclear or borderline deals to leadership — never force a file through



Communication & Reporting



Provide consistent daily end-of-day (EOD) updates: completed, pending, needs attention

Communicate professionally and clearly with borrowers throughout the loan process

Proactively surface open loops, urgent items, and potential issues without being asked

Log all borrower conversations and decisions in the CRM accurately and promptly



Important Authority Boundaries



You will prepare, organize, and pre-qualify deals — but you will not approve loans, set terms, or make funding decisions. All approvals and final decisions stay with internal leadership.

Requirements



2+ years experience in real estate transactions, loan processing, or lending support

Strong attention to detail and organization

Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients

Ability to manage multiple deals at once without dropping follow-ups

Experience using CRMs and pipeline-based systems

Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Private money, hard money, or creative real estate (subject-to, seller finance) experience

Familiarity with real estate investing terminology and underwriting basics (ARV, LTV, HUDs, exit strategy)

Experience pulling comps (e.g., PropStream, Redfin)

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience



What Success Looks Like



Clean, accurate CRM records with every lead answered

Deals move smoothly with minimal rework

Files reach leadership complete and ready for underwriting

Borrowers feel informed and supported

Leadership does not need to fix or chase files



Growth Path



Strong performers move into expanded responsibility: full pipeline management without daily supervision, loan-file audits, lead generation in investor communities, weekly pipeline and loan-admin reporting, and coordinating document requests with borrowers and title companies.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why you're an excellent fit for this role. Include the word "Lending" in your application message so we know you read this fully.

title: Viral Content Researcher & Psychology Strategist
description:
MUST WATCH THIS YOUTUBE VIDEO FIRST ***MUST FULLY UNDERSTAND :)









Overview



I'm looking for someone who can find viral videos, understand why they worked, and repurpose the underlying psychology into original content using the music below.



MUSIC







This is not just about finding cool videos. I need someone who can explain the **hook, curiosity gap, emotional arc, pacing, identity appeal, and why viewers felt compelled to share it**.



A strong candidate should be able to look at a viral video, ignore the surface-level topic, identify the deeper psychological structure, and then show how those same principles could be applied to a completely different concept using my music.



You are not limited to one niche. You can explore animals, sports, comedy, satisfying videos, storytelling, food, travel, real-life 
nts, animation, AI visuals, or any other category with viral potential.



## What You Will Do



* Find viral videos across TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels.

* Reverse-engineer why they worked.

* Identify repeatable viral formats.

* Explain the psychology behind the hook, pacing, emotion, and shareability.

* Create original content concepts using my music.

* Avoid copying videos directly. The goal is to extract the psychology, not steal the content.



## Every Video Breakdown Must Include



* Original video link

* Platform

* Views

* Hook

* Curiosity gap

* Emotional arc

* Pacing / editing rhythm

* Identity appeal

* Why people shared it

* Story structure

* How the concept can be repurposed with my music



## Six Principles You Should Understand



1. Familiarity beats originality.

2. The brain chooses before the viewer consciously d
.

3. Curiosity keeps people watching.

4. People connect with identity and emotion.

5. People share what makes them look good.

6. Strong videos follow a story: Hook ? Problem ? Story ? Payoff.



## Trial Task



Find 3 viral videos and explain:



1. Why each video went viral.

2. What psychological principles were used.

3. How you would create a completely different concept using my music while keeping the same viral structure.



I'm looking for deep thinking, not surface-level answers.

title: OPEN-SOURCE AI AUTOMATION ENGINEER
description:
Open-Source AI Automation Engineer



About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Open-Source AI Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain AI-powered systems using primarily open-source and self-hosted technologies. The goal is to create scalable automation infrastructure that can be reused across multiple businesses, websites, applications, and brands while minimizing ongoing software subscription costs.

This is not a prompt engineering role. We are looking for a technical builder who can develop complete AI-driven systems, automate business operations, connect software platforms, and deploy self-hosted solutions.



Responsibilities

 • Design and build AI-powered automation systems using open-source technologies

 •  Develop reusable frameworks that can be deployed across multiple websites, brands, and business models

 • Build and maintain websites, web applications, dashboards, and internal business tools

 • Integrate APIs, databases, CRMs, communication platforms, and third-party software

 • Develop automated workflows for content publishing, marketing, customer service, operations, and analytics

 • Create systems that can be duplicated and customized for different industries, niches, and geographic markets

 • Self-host and maintain automation infrastructure whenever practical

 • Continuously identify opportunities to replace manual processes with AI-powered automation



Required Technical Skills

 • Python development

 • JavaScript/TypeScript development

 • API integrations and webhooks

 • PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar databases

 • Docker and containerized deployments

 • Linux server administration

 • WordPress and headless CMS platforms

 • AI model integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, open-weight models)

 • Git and version control



Preferred Experience

 • Self-hosted AI infrastructure

 • AI agents and multi-agent systems

 • RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)

 • Local LLM deployment

 • Web scraping and data collection

 • SEO automation

 • Content publishing systems

 • Cloud infrastructure management

 • Mobile app development

 • Business process automation



Example Projects

 • Automated news and content websites that discover, research, write, and publish content within approved topics

 • AI-powered customer support systems

 • Automated social media publishing and content creation

 • Internal business dashboards and reporting systems

 • Lead generation and CRM automation

 • Multi-brand content and marketing platforms

 • AI-powered research and monitoring systems

 • Workflow automation across operations, marketing, and customer service



Preferred Technology Stack

 • n8n

 • Flowise

 • Langflow

 • PostgreSQL

 • Supabase

 • Docker

 • Linux

 • WordPress

 • Python

 • OpenAI API

 • Gemini API

 • Open-source AI models when appropriate



Objective

Build a centralized, open-source AI automation ecosystem that can launch, manage, and scale multiple websites, applications, content platforms, and business operations from a single reusable infrastructure.

title: Finance Manager CFO accountant – E-Commerce (Dropshipping, Shopify, Stripe, Xero, QBO)  Hong Kong
description:
About Us:

We are a high-revenue dropshipping company managing 10 webshops, operating internationally with millions in revenue across multiple currencies. We run our stores on Shopify, process payments through Stripe/Shopify Payments, and work closely with a Chinese agent who provides daily order fulfillment and product pricing.



(Our company is based in Hong Kong, so experience with Hong Kong accounting practices is an added advantage.)



We are looking for a finance professional who understands the financial operations of dropshipping, including daily supplier cost verification, reconciliation of order payouts, and multi-currency expense tracking. 





Key Responsibilities:

-Financial Reporting: Use Xero or QBO to prepare monthly/daily,weekly profit & loss statements, revenue breakdowns, and cost analysis to track business performance.

-Payment & Order Reconciliation: Verify daily Stripe and Shopify Payments payouts and match them against actual order revenue in Shopify.

-Supplier Cost Verification: Check daily product prices from our Chinese agent, ensuring they match our internal calculations before approving payments.

-Expense Management:  Categorize, and reconcile all expenses, including supplier payments and operational costs.

- Multi-Currency Management: Handle USD, EUR, SEK, and other currency transactions, ensuring accurate exchange rate application and tracking foreign exchange fees.

- Supplier & Logistics Payments: Oversee and process payments to our Chinese agent and suppliers, ensuring correct pricing, volume discounts, and delivery costs.

- Payroll & Team Payouts: Manage contractor payments and team salaries, ensuring everything aligns with agreed terms.

Cost Optimization: Identify ways to improve profitability by analyzing supplier costs, payment processing fees, and operational expenses.

- Financial Auditing: Conduct periodic checks on financial transactions, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and best practices.

Automation & Tech: Leverage tools like Xero, Dext, Expensify, Shopify, and Stripe to streamline financial processes and reporting.





Requirements:

-Experience in e-commerce finance management, specifically dropshipping (Shopify & Stripe required).

-Knowledge of Xero/QBO (or similar accounting software) for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.

-Experience o track expenses, invoices, and financial records.

-Familiarity with working with Chinese suppliers, including daily price verification, invoice reconciliation, and supplier payment processing.

-Ability to reconcile Shopify orders, Stripe payouts, and supplier payments efficiently.-

Multi-currency experience – understanding of exchange rates and international payment reconciliation.

-Strong analytical and attention-to-detail skills to verify order pricing and supplier invoices.

-Excellent English communication skills and the ability to liaise with suppliers, teams, and financial institutions.

-Previous experience in high-volume e-commerce transactions is a must.





What We Offer:

- Competitive salary based on experience.

- Work with a fast-growing international dropshipping company.

- Opportunities for growth into leadership and management roles.

- Flexible working hours (but availability for urgent finance matters is needed).





How to Apply:

To apply, submit your resume and a detailed cover letter explaining your experience with dropshipping financial management, Xero, QBO, Shopify, Stripe, and supplier cost reconciliation. The more details you provide (past job experience, testimonials, relevant skills), the better we can assess your fit.

Include the word “GREEN” somewhere in your application as our secret handshake!

3+ years editing short-form video, with real experience editing for Meta /
 & Instagram paid ads (not just organic or YouTube).



A portfolio of direct-response ad creative. 



Show us ads that were built to sell, ideally with performance context.

Genuinely current with AI video tools. You experiment with new ones the week they drop, not the year after

Fast turnarounds without babysitting. 



You manage your own queue, hit deadlines, and communicate proactively

Proactive and opinionated.

NICE TO HAVE



Understanding of direct-response copy and ad structure (hooks, leads, CTAs)

Familiarity with ad testing frameworks and reading basic ad metrics (CTR, hook rate, ROAS)

Real creative ownership and room to test your own ideas.



A team that ships fast and values initiative over process.

title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry brand using AI influencers. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for short-form videos, character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — training provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen to other virality-native illustrated character storytelling styles. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated (your art has an opinionated, taste driven direction, not general). You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



To confirm you've read the full posting, include the phrase "character-first" in your application

Use at least 7 apply points.



Shortlisted candidates move into a paid two-week trial that may convert to a confirmed monthly retainer.

title: Remote IT Patch Management & Monitoring Specialist
description:
**About Us**  

Davis IT is a growing US-based Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in HIPAA-compliant IT services for medical practices and clinics across the United States. We focus on proactive support, strong cybersecurity, and keeping systems running smoothly so our clients can focus on patient care.



We are building out our overnight operations capability to handle critical after-hours work — especially patch management and alert monitoring — during the hours when our client offices are closed and cannot perform reboots or maintenance during the day.



**Position Overview**  

We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented professional to join us as an **Overnight IT Patch Management & Monitoring Specialist**.  



This is primarily a **Tier 1 / 2 technical role** with two core focus areas:  

- Performing patch management and system updates via our RMM platform during approved overnight maintenance windows  

- Continuous monitoring and triage of alerts from RMM, cybersecurity, backup, and network platforms  



You will also provide limited after-hours support, mainly through ticketing and internal escalation (direct client phone interaction is expected to be very infrequent).  



**Important Working Hours Note**  

This is a **night shift position** when viewed from the United States (US Central Time). You will be working while our US clients’ offices are closed.  



Because of the time difference, for tea
mbers located in the **Philippines** (and similar time zones), these hours fall during **standard daytime / early evening working hours locally**. This is true night-shift work from the client’s perspective, performed during your local daytime.



**Working Style, Supervision & Probation**  

You will be expected to work with a high degree of independence and minimal direct real-time supervision once you complete initial training and onboarding.  



However, this role includes:  

- A structured **probationary period** with active performance monitoring, quality reviews of documentation, and adherence to procedures.  

- **Graduated system access** using a least-privilege model. You will not receive full administrative access immediately. Access will be expanded progressively as competency, reliability, and judgment are demonstrated.  

- Clear expectations that success depends on strictly following documented SOPs and runbooks, maintaining excellent documentation, and escalating appropriately rather than making high-impact decisions independently.  



This approach protects our clients’ sensitive healthcare environments while still allowing you to operate efficiently with autonomy.



**Key Responsibilities**  

- Execute patch management: deploy Windows updates, security patches, and approved application updates using our primary RMM platform (Datto RMM) and related tools during designated overnight maintenance windows. Verify successful installation and perform approved reboots.  

- Monitor and respond to alerts from RMM dashboards, cybersecurity tools (Guardz, CyberCNS, ThreatLocker, Sentinel One, etc.), backup systems, and network monitoring platforms.  

- Triage alerts according to severity and follow established runbooks. Perform basic approved remediation or escalate following defined procedures.  

- Maintain thorough, accurate documentation of all activities, i
, and resolutions in our ticketing system and IT documentation platform (IT Glue).  

- Prepare clear shift handover reports for the daytime team.  

- Strictly follow change management processes and security/compliance procedures required in HIPAA-regulated environments.  

- Provide limited after-hours support — primarily via ticketing and internal coordination (direct inbound client calls are rare).  



**Requirements**  

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (all tickets, documentation, and team communication are in English).  

- 2+ years of hands-on IT support, helpdesk, MSP, or NOC experience at Tier 1 or Tier 2 level.  

- Experience with patch management and RMM tools (Datto RMM, ConnectWise Automate, Kaseya, or similar) is **strongly preferred**.  

- Comfortable working independently, following detailed procedures, and maintaining high standards of documentation.  

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, and a modern computer capable of running multiple monitoring and remote access tools.  

- Availability for consistent shifts covering **US Central Time overnight hours** (core window approximately 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM CDT/CST or similar). We can discuss exact start/end times and days (typically 5 nights per week) during interviews.  

- Must demonstrate reliability, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and data security.  

- MSP experience, healthcare IT background, or relevant certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+) are advantages. Full training on our tools and processes will be provided.  



**Schedule**  

Full-time position (~40 hours per week). This is **night shift work from the US client perspective** and aligns with **daytime working hours locally in the Philippines**. We are flexible on precise start and end times within the overnight window as long as key patching and monitoring coverage is maintained. Exact schedule will be finalized during the interview process.



**Compensation & Benefits**  

- Competitive hourly compensation based on experience (please state your expected hourly rate in USD in your application).  

- Long-term, stable direct-hire opportunity with a professional US healthcare-focused MSP.  

- Structured training on our RMM platform, security tools, documentation systems, and compliance processes.  

- Fully remote work-from-home role.  

- Supportive team with clear processes, escalation paths, and opportunities to develop skills in enterprise MSP tools.  



**How to Apply**  

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include the following in your application or cover letter:  



1. Confirmation of your availability for US Central Time overnight shifts (and your preferred/available hours if flexible).  

2. Summary of your relevant IT experience, especially patch management, RMM tools, or alert monitoring work. Please list specific tools you have used.  

3. Your expected hourly rate in USD.  

4. Confirmation that you have (or can quickly set up) a quiet workspace with reliable high-speed internet and a capable computer.  

5. A short statement on why you are interested in this independent overnight role supporting US medical practices.  



We review applications promptly. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview (video or chat) and may be asked to complete a brief practical scenario exercise focused on patching or alert handling.  



We are looking for someone reliable who can work independently while following our processes and protecting our clients’ environments.

title: Social Media Video Post-Production Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a leading Australian caravan manufacturer and reseller, dedicated to building and delivering premium, adventure-ready caravans for the rugged Australian landscape. From off-road tourers to luxury family layouts, we create vehicles that inspire freedom. We are expanding our digital marketing team to showcase our builds, customer journeys, and lifestyle content through high-impact, driving video campaigns.



The Role



We are looking for a creative, fast-paced Social Media Video Post-Production Specialist to take our raw video assets—including product walk-throughs, factory builds, customer handovers, and rugged lifestyle footage—and turn them into high-performing video content.



In this role, you will analyse competitor benchmarks and reference content to craft thumb-stopping organic videos and highly optimised paid ads. Your work will directly fuel our presence across Meta 
 & Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube (including Google Ads).



Key Responsibilities



• Multi-Platform Video Editing: Cut, pace, and assemble high-impact short-form and mid-form videos customised for Meta Ads/Reels/Feeds, TikTok, and Google Ads, YouTube Shorts/Long-form.



• Paid Ad Optimisation: Build and iterate variations of high-converting video ads specifically for Meta and YouTube Ads, focusing on strong hooks, clear call-to-actions (CTAs), and direct-response formatting.



• Competitor & Reference Matching: Analyse provided competitor content, industry trends, and visual benchmarks to reverse-engineer high-performing video formats and elevate our brand's production value.



• Graphics & Text Overlays: Integrate clean typography, bold captions, lower thirds, and motion graphics optimised for mobile viewing (ensuring text stays within platform safe zones).



• Audio & Colour Correction: Perform crisp audio mixing (balancing wind noise, voiceovers, background tracks, and trending SFX) and apply clean, natural colour grading to make outdoor and lifestyle footage pop.



• Asset Pipeline Management: Maintain a highly organised digital library of raw footage, b-roll (factory, off-road, interior details), and completed masters for quick access and re-editing.



Capabilities & Core Skills



• Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of professional editing suites like Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, alongside After Effects for motion graphics.



• Direct-Response Awareness: An understanding of what drives digital engagement and conversions—knowing how to hook an adventure-seeking audience within the first 3 seconds.



• Adaptability to Brand Voice: Ability to switch gears between rugged, high-energy off-road action edits and clean, aspirational, lifestyle-focused family caravan tours.



• Autonomous Workflow: Self-motivated and comfortable taking a folder of raw footage alongside reference links and turning it into a polished, final cut with minimal hand-holding.



Requirements



• Experience: 2+ years of video post-production experience, with a heavy emphasis on social media content and paid social video ads (automotive, travel, or outdoor leisure industry experience is a major plus).



• Portfolio/Reel: A robust portfolio demonstrating your editing pace, motion graphics, use of text/captions, and specifically showcasing successful ads or social media edits.



• Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the Australian outdoor, camping, or automotive market layout is highly regarded but not strictly required.



• Adaptability: Ability to turn around high-quality content under tight deadlines and version assets into multiple cutdowns and platform resizing.



• Collaboration: Strong English communication skills to take constructive feedback from creative directors and content strategists.



HOURS per WEEK: Variable week to week  min 8 Hours - unlimited

This is not just a “make it look nice” editing role. We are looking for someone who understands the difference between a beautiful edit and an effective ad.



You should be able to look at a video and think:



“Where would someone drop off?”

 “How do we make the hook stronger?”

 “Does this feel native to the platform?”

 “Does the edit support the angle?”

 “Is this persuasive from a consumer’s perspective?”



You will work closely with creative strategists, media buyers, and creative directors to edit paid social ads for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate has strong instincts around hooks, pacing, retention, direct response structure, captions, audio, b-roll, AI tools, and what makes content feel native to platforms like Meta, Instagram, and TikTok.



You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve the creative process. This may include generating natural-looking filler footage, creating product b-roll, producing AI voiceovers, transcribing scenes, analyzing competitor ads, or speeding up editing workflows.



What You’ll Do



Edit Paid Social Ads



- Edit performance-driven video ads for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and other short-form platforms 

- Turn raw UGC, talking-head footage, testimonials, product demos, founder content, and creator-style clips into finished ads 

- Create multiple hooks, angles, and video variations for creative testing 

-  Build strong first-three-second hooks with visual impact 

-  Repurpose existing footage into new ad concepts and variations 

-  Make videos feel native to the platform, not like overproduced brand commercials 



Bring Direct Response Creative Instincts



-  Edit videos around direct response structures such as problem, agitation, solution, proof, and CTA 

- Match the editing style to the footage, offer, brand, and creative angle 

- Know when an ad should feel organic, handheld, raw, and native 

- Know when an ad should feel more polished, premium, or brand-forward 

- Use pacing, captions, pattern interrupts, b-roll, visual proof, and sound to keep people watching 

- Make the ad feel cohesive rather than stitched together with random filler 

- Think from the consumer’s perspective, not just the editor’s perspective 



Improve Hooks, Pacing, and Retention



- Strengthen hook visuals and opening 
nts 

- Improve pacing, scene order, and visual flow 

- Add captions, overlays, text callouts, screenshots, sound cues, and pattern interrupts 

- Identify 
nts where viewers may drop off and improve the edit accordingly 

- Create edits that are clear, engaging, persuasive, and easy to follow 

- Use sound design and audio pacing to make videos more engaging 



Use AI Tools in the Creative Workflow



- Use AI tools to generate natural-looking filler footage or additional product b-roll when client footage is limited 

- Match AI-generated footage to the quality, lighting, environment, and realism of the original clips 

- Use AI voiceover tools when applicable 

- Use AI tools for transcription, scene analysis, competitor ad comparison, and creative research 

- Understand when AI improves an edit and when it makes the video feel unnatural 

- Stay curious about new creative tools and workflows 



Collaborate With the Creative Team



- Read creative briefs and ask smart questions when something is unclear 

- Communicate estimated completion times before starting work 

- Send an initial draft for review when working on a new format or a brief with multiple variants 

- Take feedback from strategists, media buyers, and creative directors 

- Revise quickly and communicate clearly around blockers, timelines, and priorities 

- Pull inspiration from winning ads, organic content, competitor ads, and top creators 

- Recommend new creative angles, hooks, structures, and references when appropriate 



You’re a Great Fit If...



- You have 2 to 5+ years of video editing experience 

- You have experience editing paid social ads, UGC-style content, short-form content, or DTC ecommerce ads 

- You understand what makes content feel native to Meta, Instagram, TikTok, and Reels 

- You have strong instincts for hooks, pacing, retention, and visual flow 

- You understand direct response advertising and performance creative 

- You can tell the difference between content that is visually aesthetic and content that is persuasive to a consumer 

- You know how to adapt the edit based on the footage style, whether it should feel raw and organic or polished and premium 

- You are strong with captions, typography, sound design, overlays, and voiceover pacing 

- You can create multiple ad variations quickly without sacrificing quality 

- You ask questions when a brief is unclear 

- You communicate clearly about timelines, revisions, and blockers 

- You are comfortable using AI tools in your creative workflow 

- You have a strong sense of what keeps viewers watching 



Tools You Should Be Comfortable With



You do not need to know every tool listed, but you should be fast at learning new creative tools.



- Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve 

- CapCut 

- Meta ad creative references and competitor research 

- TikTok native editor 

- Instagram native editor 

- ElevenLabs or similar AI voiceover tools 

- Higgsfield or similar AI image and video tools 

- Gemini, ChatGPT, or similar tools for transcription, scene analysis, and creative research 

- AI tools for image, video, voiceover, b-roll, and clip generation 

- Google Drive, Slack, Notion, 
, or similar collaboration tools 



Nice to Have



- Experience editing direct response DTC ads 

- Experience working with paid social creative teams 

- Experience editing Meta ads specifically 

- Experience researching Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, or competitor ads 

- Experience creating viral organic short-form content 

- Experience creating platform-native content for TikTok, Instagram, or Reels 

- Experience inside a marketing agency 

- Motion graphics or typography skills 

- Understanding of Meta and TikTok ad performance metrics 

- A strong portfolio of UGC, paid social, or organic short-form edits 

- Experience with AI-generated b-roll, AI voiceovers, or AI-assisted editing workflows

title: Right-Hand VA (Marketing Focused) — Clean Christian Music App
description:
We're looking for a sharp, creative, trend-obsessed marketer who lives on social media and loves using AI to make great content faster and smarter. The heart of this role is organic social — finding what's working right now, testing new content types before everyone else does, and turning scrolls into follows, clicks, and customers. You'll have real ownership over what we post, how it performs, and where we grow next.



If you get a little thrill from spotting a trend early, trying a format nobody's done yet, watching the analytics climb, and making a piece of content better than you found it — you'll fit right in. You don't need to have done all of this before, but you do need to be excited to learn. We use AI every day, and you'll use it to move faster: drafting, repurposing, researching, and creating gorgeous visuals.



It's a mixed role, and we want to be upfront about that. Organic social and marketing are the core of what we're hiring for — but you'll also help with customer service for our clean Christian music app, a bit of general admin, and whatever else a small, growing team needs. You need to be genuinely open to pitching in wherever we need you. We use tools like Claude (and Claude Code) every day, and we'll teach you how we work.



If you anticipate what's needed before being asked, take real ownership, communicate like a pro, and love learning something new — keep reading.



We're hiring the person, not the résumé. Creativity, instincts, and drive matter most; the rest we can teach — including the AI tools we build with.



What you'll do



Own our organic social (the core). Plan, create, and post across our platforms; catch trends early and act on them fast; test new content types and formats; build engaged audiences and keep them growing. This is the heart of the role.



Make scroll-stopping content — with an eye for design. Create visuals that look premium and on-brand, using AI image tools (Midjourney, Ideogram, gpt-image, and friends) to produce gorgeous images quickly. Good taste matters here.



Grow beyond organic. Pitch in on
 marketing, funnels, paid ads, and influencer marketing as we scale. You don't need to be an expert in all of it — but you should be eager to learn it and run with it.



Turn data into insight. Monitor analytics across platforms, spot what's working (and what's not), and bring us clear takeaways — not just numbers. Then double down on the winners.



Use AI to work faster and smarter. Lean on Claude / ChatGPT (and grow into Claude Code) to draft content, repurpose it across platforms, research, and automate the tedious parts of content ops. We'll teach you; you bring the curiosity.



Be my right hand. Anticipate needs, follow through without reminders, flag issues early, and close loops.



Support our clean Christian music app — content, community, customer service, and launch-related help.



Pitch in on the rest — light e-commerce / Etsy support and general admin as we grow.



A real love of music is a big plus — you'll be working in it every day.



Who you are (this matters most to us)



Creative and trend-obsessed — this is the big one. You live on social, you catch trends before they peak, and you have strong instincts for what makes people stop, save, and share.



An eye for design. You know what looks good, and you can create (or AI-assist) visuals that feel premium and on-brand.



Very proactive — a true self-starter. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told, teach yourself what you don't know, and your first instinct on a repetitive task is "can I make this faster?"



Tech-curious and AI-friendly. You're energized (not intimidated) by AI tools, and you're excited to use them every day to create and move faster. Any interest in automation or tinkering is a real plus.



Comfortable with numbers. You actually look at the analytics and let them guide your next test.



Great — not necessarily experienced. Eager, smart, proactive, and resourceful. We'd take a brilliant fast-learner over a seasoned coaster every single time.



Open and flexible. Happy to jump from a content project to a customer-service question to a quick admin task without missing a beat. You're here for the creative and marketing work, but you don't consider anything "below" you.



A clear communicator — responsive, easy to work with, and good at keeping us in the loop.



Reliable and professional — you do what you say you'll do, and you have a stable internet connection good enough to hold a video call and screen-share without dropping.



Honest and accountable — you log the time you actually work and speak up early when something's off. This one is non-negotiable.



Detail-oriented. To show us you read carefully, please mention your favorite color in your application where it asks how you heard about us.



Mission-aligned — you genuinely connect with what we're building: clean, faith-friendly music for families.



Helpful (but NOT required — we'll train you)



Hands-on organic social experience (TikTok, Instagram / Reels, Pinterest, YouTube Shorts,
).

Any experience with
 marketing, funnels, paid ads (Meta, etc.), or influencer marketing.

AI image generation (Midjourney, Ideogram, gpt-image) and design tools (Canva, Figma, etc.).

Using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your daily workflow — bonus points for Claude / Claude Code or automation (n8n, Make, Zapier).

Reading analytics to spot trends and report results.

Pinterest / social media scheduling tools.

Customer service experience.

WordPress publishing.

Influencer outreach and management.

The details



Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term.

We start at $400–500/month and there's room to grow — in both pay and responsibility — as you take on more and grow into the wider marketing and AI side.

Based in the Philippines, with some flexibility to occasionally overlap U.S. Mountain Time for a quick call or chat.

We use the time tracker Trackabi for active work hours.

Benefits



Flexible hours — days, nights, spread out, or catch up on weekends.

PTO after 6 months full-time.

Paid training time to learn new skills on the clock.

A genuinely great team and culture. I treat my team like friends, not just freelancers — many have been with me for years, with no plans of leaving.

How to apply



Apply through the Google Form here:
 — that's the only way to apply, so please don't DM or
 instead.



Two quick things in the form:



When it asks about your experience with AI tools, tell us about a time you taught yourself something new — a tool, a content format, or a campaign — what you did and how it turned out. There's no "right" answer; we just want to see how you think and learn.



We're hiring one person and reviewing applications as they come in. Top candidates get a paid test project — your real chance to show us how you work.



If creating content, chasing trends, and using AI to do it all faster sounds more like a chore than something you'd genuinely enjoy, this probably isn't the right fit — and that's completely okay. But if everything above sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to meet you.

title: 3D Artist / Motion Designer Wanted
description:
Project Overview: I am a livestreaming musician looking for a talented 3D Artist / Motion Designer to build a series of highly atmospheric virtual stages. These will serve as pre-rendered video backgrounds behind a physical green screen using Ecamm Live to broadcast weekly live virtual concerts. Since the performance changes and evolves each week, and new shows with different stage backgrounds are in production, the right candidate could be employed consistently for roughly 10 hours a week or more for the long-term. 



The core aesthetic for this project is a vast, eerie cathedral or ancient monastery (dark gothic architecture, towering arches, stained glass, dimly lit corridors). A central element of this stage will be a mystical, magical video projection integrated into the environment and a single performer playing guitar and keyboards integrated seamlessly into the virtual stage. 



Key Responsibilities:

 • 3D Environment Modeling: Design a grand, gothic cathedral or monastery interior featuring large pillars, stone textures, and dramatic architectural depth.

 • Virtual Screen Integration: Seamlessly embed a 16:9 aspect ratio projection area into the cathedral background that plays video files provided by me. The screen should be styled as a magical, mystical projection (e.g., hovering ethereal mist, a magical energy field, or glowing ancient runes) rather than a modern LED wall.

 • Multi-Angle Perspective: Distort and skew the embedded 16:9 video playback window so it realistically matches the perspective and depth of a few different camera angles focused on the performer.

 • Lighting & Animation: Create eerie, moody light shows (flickering candlelight, moonlight piercing through stained glass, pulsing low-light columns, and lasers) looped to a steady tempo.

 • Atmospheric Visual Effects (VFX): Integrate thick volumetric stage fog, floating dust motes/particles, and realistic light shafts to create a haunting sense of scale.

 • Seamless Rendering: Export perfectly looping video files with zero visible cuts or jumps upon looping.



Required Skills and Qualifications:

 • Expertise in Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, Autodesk Maya or whatever software gets the job done. 

 • Strong portfolio showcasing gothic, dark fantasy, or grand historical 3D environments.

 • Experience embedding external video textures/materials into a 3D environment with proper perspective warping.

 • Deep understanding of volumetric lighting, god rays, and atmospheric fog rendering.

 • Ability to structure the composition to leave a clear "performer pocket" in the center frame.



Technical Deliverables:

 • Format: MP4 or MOV

 • Resolution: 1080p (16:9 aspect ratio).

 • Framerate: 30fps

 • Duration: 30-to-60-second seamless loops.



Application Process & Screening Test

To be considered for this position, please reply with the following information:

 • A link to your portfolio, ArtStation, or video reel highlighting your best dark fantasy, gothic, or realistic 3D environments.

 • Your preferred 3D creation software.



Please use the phrase "DARK GOTHIC STAGE" as the subject of your application message.

title: Takeoff Estimator (Junior) — Australian Concrete / FRP Drawings — Remote, Per Project
description:
About

Australian construction company — formwork, reinforcement and concrete (FRP) on civil, bridge and commercial jobs. I need someone to do quantity takeoffs off Australian drawings and build reusable assemblies in ZZTakeoff. You do the measuring — I handle the rates and the commercial side. Paid per job. Long-term for the right person.



What you'll do

- Quantity takeoffs off Australian structural and civil drawings — areas, lengths, volumes, bar and mesh.

- Build and reuse assemblies in ZZTakeoff.

- Apply rates I give you into a priced schedule / BOQ.

- Return clean Excel output, measured accurately, checked against the drawings.



Must have

- Can read Australian structural and civil drawings confidently. Metric (m, m², m³, t). This is the main thing — if you can't read the drawings, don't apply.

- Some takeoff or estimating experience (concrete, formwork, reinforcement or civil).

- Takeoff software — ZZTakeoff ideal; Bluebeam, PlanSwift or CostX fine (you'll move to ZZTakeoff).

- Good written English. Accurate and careful — accuracy beats speed.



Nice to have

- Concrete / formwork / reinforcement knowledge. TfNSW or AS standards exposure.



You do NOT need to be a senior QS. Junior is fine. I'll teach the FRP specifics — you bring drawing literacy and accurate measuring.



Pay

Paid per project — most jobs USD $30–150 depending on size, larger jobs more. Starts with a paid trial (one takeoff). Ongoing per-bid work and steady volume for the right person.



Hours

Flexible, but you need to overlap a few hours with Sydney time (AEST).

title: Full-Time Web Designer & Developer – Remote (Philippines-Based)
description:

We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term. If you’re juggling multiple clients or short-term gigs, this may not be the right fit.



Monthly Salary

$1,300 USD/month

Paid biweekly or monthly via EasyPay

Includes 13th-month bonus and PH holiday leave

This role is for a highly skilled and proactive developer — not entry-level.



Job Description

Frisco Web Agency is hiring a full-time Web Designer & Developer to join our remote team. We're a fast-growing U.S.-based web design and SEO agency that builds custom, high-performing websites to help small businesses grow.

You’ll work directly with the founder to implement websites end-to-end using detailed SOPs, checklists, and playbooks. This is a high-ownership, execution-first role — not passive support work. You must be proactive, detail-oriented, and ready to lead your function.

If you're a creative problem-solver who thrives on clarity, structure, and high standards — and wants long-term career growth, provision, and impact — we want to hear from you.



Responsibilities

Build and update websites using mainly Webflow, and sometimes WordPress, Squarespace, and Wix

Write clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to enhance site functionality

Implement SEO best practices (semantic HTML, headings, schema, internal linking)

Execute all development tasks using SOPs and checklists

Build embeds, global classes, and reusable components

Troubleshoot and fix technical SEO issues in Ahrefs and GSC

Use tools like ImageFX and stock sites for visuals

Perform responsive QA reviews across browsers/devices

Follow and implement brand guidelines (fonts, colors, logo usage, etc.)

Collaborate on wireframe approvals in Relume

Operate inside tools like ClickUp, ChatGPT, Beam Us Up, and GoHighLevel

Document all recurring tasks via Loom, Google Docs, or internal wikis

Communicate proactively and set realistic timelines

Join team syncs daily — twice a day for the first 30 days



Non-Responsibilities

You will not:

Manage ads (but will collaborate with the ads team)

Write full marketing copy (but should understand web-friendly phrasing)

Build complex backend systems (but must navigate dev tools confidently)

Lead UI design (but must understand and implement clean design principles)

Manage SEO strategy (but will implement SEO-related technical tasks and uploads)



Minimum Requirements

Fluent written and verbal English

Excellent attention to detail and task follow-through

Strong grasp of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

Experience working on multiple website platforms

Understanding of UX and web design principles

Ability to follow SOPs and documented processes

Experience with ClickUp or another PM tool

Ownership mindset — solves problems without needing hand-holding

Deadline-driven and communicative

Fast learner with initiative to self-research

Proactive and independent — not reactive or passive



Preferred Skills (Can Be Taught During Onboarding)

Webflow (CMS, components, animations, custom code)

Relume for wireframes and approvals

ImageFX or AI tools for image generation

Finsweet tools and attributes

Basic SEO tools: Ahrefs, GSC, schema

Canva or Photoshop (for basic visual edits)

Familiarity with Beam Us Up, Loom, Airtable, GoHighLevel, Make/Zapier

Comfortable creating documentation (screen recordings, SOPs, how-tos)



What We Expect in the First 30 Days

Navigate core tools: Webflow, ClickUp, Ahrefs, GSC, Relume

Understand our use of CMS, embeds, and global components

Begin resolving technical SEO issues

Build pages using pre-approved wireframes and SOPs

Document all repeatable processes as you learn them

Show proactive communication, fast turnaround, and organized task tracking



Technical Requirements

Stable internet connection: 10 Mbps minimum

Reliable laptop or desktop (preferably 8GB RAM or more)

Backup internet or mobile hotspot plan

Quiet environment for virtual meetings



Culture & Values

Our team is faith-driven, purpose-led, and committed to building with integrity, stewardship, and excellence. We work fast, take ownership, and honor one another in all interactions.

If that resonates with you — and you’re ready for a high-growth, high-trust environment — we’d love to hear from you.



How to Apply

To apply, you must follow these instructions. Failure to follow them will result in automatic disqualification.

 us with the subject line:

 "Skilled Developer Application – [Your Name]"

Include:

A short paragraph about your web development background and why this job interests you

Links to 2–3 past projects (live websites or portfolio links — required)

Your resume (PDF format preferred)

Your answer to this question:

 “What is one thing you believe makes a website both beautiful and effective?”

Optional but preferred: A screenshot of your current internet speed using Speedtest.net

What’s your dream job 1–2 years from now?

Why are you looking for something long-term?

What type of team do you thrive on?



Final Note

We review all applications thoroughly. Finalists will be invited to complete a paid trial task to demonstrate skill, communication, and attention to detail. We are looking for someone who will own this position — and grow with us for years.

Please do not use AI to write your application. We want to hear directly from you — in your own words.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

[After Regularization]

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

Employment Type



Full-time remote roleAustralian business hours overlap requiredLong-term position for the right person

We service homeowners, tenants, property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, hospitality businesses and facilities managers across Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba and surrounding areas.

This is not a basic social media posting role. We need someone who understands paid advertising, lead generation, tracking, landing pages, retargeting, campaign testing, conversion rates, content strategy and customer retention.

 Ads, Instagram Ads and social media marketing across several of our businesses.

title: Amazon Account Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, autonomous Amazon Account Specialist to take full ownership of our Seller Central operations. This isn't a role for someone who just follows a script; we need a problem-solver who understands the "why" behind Amazon’s rules and knows how to navigate them effectively. You will be the sole point of contact for customer inquiries, account health, and tactical compliance.



Key Responsibilities

Account Health & "Tactical" Compliance: Monitor account health dashboard daily. Handle restricted product flags, documentation requests, and compliance hurdles. You should be comfortable finding creative, effective ways to resolve "non-traditional" compliance issues and navigating Amazon’s automated systems to keep listings active.



Customer Experience: Manage the daily inbox (typically 1–2 messages per day). Provide high-quality, professional responses that protect our seller rating and resolve buyer issues instantly. 



Seller Central Troubleshooting: Act as the primary liaison with Seller Support. Fight for case resolutions, fix stranded inventory, and update listing data as needed. BRAND ANALYTICS is a REQUIREMENT is needed for this role.



Operational Support: General administrative tasks related to the Amazon storefront to ensure "everything is just handled."



The Ideal Candidate

The "Amazon Veteran": You’ve been inside Seller Central long enough to know that "The Rules" and "How things actually work" are often two different things.



Smart & Adaptive: Since volume is low, we don't need a robot. We need someone who can spend their time researching new workarounds or optimizing a process when things are quiet.



High Level of Discretion: You understand the nuances of compliance in the Amazon world and can execute strategies to keep the account safe without overcomplicating simple tasks.



English Fluency: Excellent written English is a must for both customer service and drafting persuasive appeals to Amazon.



Technical Requirements

Proven experience with Amazon Seller Central (specifically Account Health and Case Logs).



Experience handling "difficult" compliance or reinstatement issues is a major plus.



Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing & Research | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.
