title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job.  You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.  



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.  

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.  









We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book.



You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page.



You are the person who answers every week:

• “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?”

• “Why did this listing drop in rank?”

• “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?”

• “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?”



What You Will Own

Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis

• Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring)

• Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition

• Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing

• Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns

• Map the competitive landscape for every product line

New Listing Launch

• Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms

• Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules

• Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team

• Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan

• Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time

• Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets



Ongoing Listing Optimization

• Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks

• Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments

• Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast

• Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves

• Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate



Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence

• Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports

• Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category

• Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword

• Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings

• Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory



Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:

• Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored)

• Listing health scorecard by ASIN

• Competitor watchlist with movement alerts

• Launch performance reports vs. plan

• Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority



Who You Are



You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are:

• A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings

• A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable)

• Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel

• Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion

• Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean

• Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends

• A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly

• Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told



Required Experience

• 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level

• Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords

• Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this)

• Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker)

• Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting

• Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs

• Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images

• Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling)

• Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them)



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN

• Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion

• At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift

• Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership

• Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases



Why This Role Matters

Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result

• How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most

• One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: Marketplace Multichannel specialist
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job. You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.



About the Role

We are looking for a multi-channel listing specialist who can build, launch, and optimize product listings across five very different marketplaces: Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Wayfair.

This is a listings-focused role. You will not be running ads or managing inventory sync — your job is to make sure every product we sell shows up clean, accurate, optimized, and conversion-ready on every channel where it lives.

You understand that each marketplace plays by its own rules. Shopify gives you total creative control. Walmart and Target demand strict content compliance and category-specific attribute precision. eBay rewards keyword density and item specifics. Wayfair is its own world of merchandising, dimensions, and class-level requirements. You know how to switch contexts and execute correctly on all five.

You are the person who asks every week:

• “Which listings are underperforming, and on which channel?”

• “Where are we missing keywords, attributes, or images?”

• “Which listings are flagged, suppressed, or non-compliant?”

• “Where is the biggest optimization opportunity this week?”

What You Will Own

Shopify

• Build product pages with SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and meta data

• Manage collections, tags, and product organization

• Configure variants, options, and inventory display

• Optimize images, alt text, and structured data for search

• Coordinate with design team on PDP layout, badges, and on-page assets

Walmart Marketplace

• Create and maintain item setups via Item Spec or bulk upload

• Optimize titles, key features, descriptions, and rich media

• Ensure full attribute completeness (Walmart’s Listing Quality Score)

• Manage category-specific compliance and content scorecards

• Resolve content errors, item processing failures, and unpublished items

Target Plus

• Build item setup files following Target’s strict content guidelines

• Write titles and copy that match Target’s brand voice and guest tone

• Manage attribute completeness, images, and enhanced content

• Work within Target Plus Partners portal to maintain item status

• Coordinate item approval and resubmission workflows

eBay

• Build listings with optimized titles (80-character usage) and complete item specifics

• Write keyword-rich descriptions structured for eBay’s search algorithm

• Use eBay’s product catalog and category-specific required fields correctly

• Manage variation listings, store categories, and promotional content

• Monitor and improve listing quality, search visibility, and Best Match positioning

Wayfair

• Build product feeds with accurate class, dimensions, materials, and merchandising attributes

• Write Wayfair-style titles, marketing copy, and bullet features that convert in their PDP layout

• Manage image requirements, lifestyle imagery, and dimension diagrams

• Resolve content rejection issues and class-level data gaps

• Maintain product data quality scores within the Wayfair Partner Home dashboard

Cross-Channel Quality & Reporting

• Maintain a master content library so titles, copy, images, and attributes stay consistent across channels

• Adapt content to each channel’s rules — never copy-paste the same listing everywhere

• Audit existing listings on every channel for gaps, errors, and optimization opportunities

• Track listing health and content scorecards on every platform

• Build a weekly status report showing active, pending, suppressed, and flagged listings by channel

Who You Are

You are not a generalist VA. You are:

• A multi-channel listing operator who has worked in at least 3 of these 5 platforms hands-on

• Fluent in the language of product data: titles, attributes, item specifics, taxonomy, GTINs, variants

• Detail-obsessed — a missing attribute or wrong category is a personal offense

• A strong writer who can shift tone between Shopify, Target, eBay, and Wayfair without thinking about it

• Comfortable working inside multiple seller portals every day

• Calm under spreadsheet pressure — you can manage hundreds of SKUs without losing track

• Self-directed — you flag issues, propose fixes, and execute without hand-holding

Required Experience

• 3+ years building and optimizing product listings on marketplaces and Shopify

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 of the following: Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, Wayfair

• Working knowledge of marketplace content quality requirements and scorecards

• Strong copywriting skills for product titles, bullets, and descriptions

• Comfortable with bulk uploads, item setup templates, and feed files (CSV / Excel)

• Strong spreadsheet skills (formulas, lookups, pivots)

• Working knowledge of product taxonomy, GTINs, UPCs, and category attribute structures

• Experience coordinating with design teams on image requirements per channel

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full content audit completed across all 5 channels

• Master content library built and maintained as source of truth

• Prioritized optimization backlog in motion, by channel

• Listing quality scores improved on Walmart, Target, and Wayfair

• Weekly multi-channel status report established with leadership

• Clear playbook documented for launching a new product across all 5 channels

Why This Role Matters

Every channel we sell on is a storefront, and every storefront is judged on its weakest listing. The right person in this seat protects our brand, lifts conversion across the board, and turns five marketplaces into five well-run businesses instead of five neglected ones.

Work Hours

Monday through Friday, Pacific Standard Time.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• Which of the 5 channels you have the most experience on, and how long

• A specific listing you built or optimized — what you changed, and the result

• The biggest difference, in your view, between writing a Shopify product page and a Walmart listing

We operate at scale across Amazon, Shopify, and wholesale—and we take profitability seriously.

Reduce wasted spend and eliminate non-performing keywords

Analyze:

TACOS trends

Conversion rates

CPC inflation

Placement performance

Search term profitability

Provide clear insights—not just reports

:hammer_and_wrench: 

Execution Excellence



Manage campaigns inside Amazon Advertising Console

Use bulk sheets and structured workflows for efficiency

Implement bid adjustments and placement strategies

Maintain clean, scalable campaign structures

Cross-Team Collaboration



Work closely with Listing Growth Specialists to:

Improve conversion rates

Support ranking initiatives



Provide input on:

Product launches

Pricing strategy

Promotional planning



:bar_chart: 

Reporting & Accountability

TACOS and profitability trends

Campaign performance breakdown

Budget allocation decisions

Scaling opportunities

Risks and issues

Non-Negotiable Requirements



4–6+ years hands-on Amazon PPC experience

Proven experience managing large-scale catalogs (500+ SKUs minimum)

Strong understanding of:

TACOS vs ACOS

Contribution margin

Break-even ACOS

Campaign structure strategy



Deep experience inside Amazon Advertising Console

Strong analytical and decision-making skills

Ability to work PST hours full-time

What We Are NOT Looking For



Task-based PPC VAs

Candidates focused only on ACOS

People who “optimize bids” without understanding profitability

Anyone without a clear campaign structure strategy

Who You Are

You:



Think in terms of profit, not spend

Understand when to scale vs protect margin

Can diagnose performance issues quickly

Make decisions using data, not opinions

Take ownership of results—not just tasks

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)



Clear understanding of account structure and performance

Campaigns restructured for efficiency and scalability

Wasteful spend reduced

High-performing keywords identified and scaled

Improved TACOS and overall profitability

Strong alignment with listing and SEO strategy

How to Apply (IMPORTANT)



Send:



Your resume

A short case study of a PPC account you managed:

What was the problem?

What actions did you take?

What was the impact on profitability?



Answer this question:

A product sells for $40 with a landed cost of $18.

Current ACOS is 30%.

What would you do?

Applications without this will not be considered.



Compensation & Growth



Competitive salary based on experience

Performance-based incentives tied to profitability improvements

Opportunity to manage and scale a large, complex catalog

Long-term growth into senior leadership role

title: Video Editor: Travel Vlogs
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented video editor to help create high-quality, engaging videos. The ideal candidate should have experience working with raw footage from phone recordings and be able to enhance content through expert editing, seamless transitions, and creative additions.



What You'll Do:

1. Tailored Workflow & Enhanced Quality: Optimize raw footage with noise reduction, audio leveling, and effects to elevate overall content quality.

2. Precise Editing & Efficiency: Edit and enhance videos while ensuring quick turnaround times without compromising quality.

3. Professional Video Editing: Deliver precise and creative edits to match the project’s needs.

4. Post-Production: Provide comprehensive post-production services to ensure polished, professional results.

5. Color Correction: Apply color grading and correction to enhance the visual appeal of videos.

6. Sound Design: Add background music, improve audio quality, and create an immersive audio experience.

7. Creative Storytelling: Make decisions on where to insert B-rolls, animations, zoom transitions, and graphics to make videos more engaging.

8. Subtitles & Captions: Add subtitles for accessibility and engagement.

9. Organizing Clips & Footage: Structure videos from beginning to end with a seamless flow.

10. Transitions & Video Effects: Implement smooth transitions and effects for a professional touch.

11. Intro & Outro: Create engaging intros and outros to enhance brand identity.

12. Multiple Revisions: Open to feedback and revisions to achieve the desired final product.



Ideal Candidate:



- Experienced in editing phone-recorded content

- Creative and detail-oriented

- Understands sound design and background music selection

- Proficient in color grading and correction

- Skilled in using professional video editing software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, etc.)

- Efficient and deadline-driven



If you're passionate about video editing and can transform raw footage into engaging, high-quality content, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Amazon Market Place Brand Strategist
description:
You must have at least 5 years of relevant experience (working for a USA brand) to apply for this position.



The Amazon Brand Strategist will oversee brand positioning, product performance, and marketing strategy across Amazon marketplaces. This role requires a blend of analytical thinking, creative direction, and marketplace expertise to drive visibility, conversion, and profitability. The strategist will act as the brand guardian on Amazon—ensuring listings, imagery, pricing, and messaging reflect our brand identity while meeting performance targets.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Brand & Product Strategy

• Develop and execute brand-specific growth strategies to increase sales and market share on Amazon.

• Analyze category trends, competitors, and consumer behavior to identify opportunities for new product launches or repositioning.

• Partner with design, photography, and content teams to ensure listings are optimized for both SEO and brand storytelling.

• Understanding of AI models and how to utilities them for meaningful growth

Listing Optimization & Content

• Oversee listing creation, A+ content, brand storefronts, and enhanced brand assets.

• Ensure all product pages align with brand voice, visual guidelines, and Amazon best practices.

• Continuously test and optimize titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend keywords for maximum visibility.

Advertising & Performance

• Collaborate with the PPC and DSP teams to align ad campaigns with brand and sales goals.

• Analyze ROI and ACOS performance, recommending adjustments to maximize profitability.

• Develop promotional calendars, seasonal campaigns, and brand-specific initiatives.

Analytics & Reporting

• Monitor KPIs such as sales velocity, conversion rate, return rate, and Buy Box share.

• Prepare detailed weekly and monthly brand performance reports, highlighting wins, risks, and opportunities.

• Use data to forecast demand and collaborate with inventory teams for replenishment planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with operations and logistics teams to ensure consistent stock levels and timely shipments.

• Partner with accounting for budget planning, pricing, and profitability analysis.

• Liaise with customer service to ensure brand consistency in post-purchase experience and review management.



Requirements:

-Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant or in a similar role, preferably within e-commerce or Amazon Seller Central.

- Strong understanding of Amazon's platform, including listing optimization, order management, and customer service.

- Experience in digital marketing and PPC campaigns.

- Familiarity with inventory management systems and logistics.

- Knowledge of SEO best practices for Amazon listings.

- Highly skilled in graphics, including building premium A+ graphics.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

- High Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and other relevant digital tools.

- Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions accurately.

- Office hours – 8AM – 430PM Pacific Standard Time.

title: HVAC Technical Operations Coordinator – Reports, Quotes, Parts & Technician Support
description:
Job Title



HVAC Technical Operations Coordinator – Remote Role for Australian Air Conditioning Company



Employment Type



Full-time remote role

Australian business hours required

Long-term position for the right person



Company Overview



KleenAir is a growing South East Queensland air conditioning, HVAC hygiene, servicing, repairs, maintenance and installation company. We work with homeowners, tenants, property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, hospitality businesses and facilities managers across Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba and surrounding areas.



We are looking for a technically minded HVAC operations person who can support our field technicians, office team and customers by preparing professional reports, diagnosis summaries, quotes, proposals, supplier orders, parts sourcing, technician follow-ups and job completion checks.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role. We need someone with real HVAC, air conditioning or refrigeration knowledge who understands how service jobs operate, how technicians work in the field, how parts and equipment are sourced, and how to communicate technical information clearly.



About the Role



You will be a key support person between our technicians, office team, suppliers and customers.



Your role will include preparing detailed service reports, fault diagnosis reports, quotes and proposals based on technician notes, photos and findings. You will also assist with supplier calls, system orders, replacement parts sourcing, delivery coordination, stock pick-up arrangements, technician job completion checks, time logs, vehicle fleet monitoring and general technical operations support.



You must be comfortable understanding air conditioning systems, technical faults, technician notes, supplier information, parts availability, installation requirements and customer-facing recommendations.



We need someone organised, accurate, reliable and technically capable.



Key Responsibilities

1. Service Reports, Diagnosis Reports & Proposals



Prepare professional service reports based on technician notes, job photos, videos and field findings.



Prepare detailed fault diagnosis reports for split systems, ducted systems and commercial air conditioning equipment.



Write clear recommendations for repairs, maintenance, replacements or further investigation.



Prepare customer quotes for air conditioning cleaning, servicing, repairs, parts replacement and installation-related work.



Prepare proposals for property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, hospitality clients and facilities managers.



Review technician photos and identify what should be included in reports.



Convert rough technician notes into polished, professional and easy-to-understand language.



Prepare before-and-after summaries for HVAC hygiene jobs.



Prepare replacement recommendations where repairs are uneconomical due to system age, parts availability or repair cost.



Ensure reports are technically accurate, well-structured and suitable for homeowners, landlords, property managers and commercial clients.



2. Supplier Communication & Parts Sourcing



Call and
 suppliers to check stock availability, pricing and lead times.



Source replacement parts for air conditioning and HVAC repair jobs.



Identify and request pricing for components such as PCBs, fan motors, compressors, capacitors, sensors, thermistors, drain pumps, zone motors, dampers, filters and other HVAC parts.



Assist with organising air conditioning system orders for installations and replacements.



Arrange supplier deliveries to job sites, office, warehouse or technician pick-up locations.



Coordinate stock pick-ups and make sure technicians know where and when parts or systems are available.



Follow up suppliers when pricing, parts confirmations or delivery updates are delayed.



Keep the office team updated on parts availability, delays and expected delivery times.



Maintain clear records of supplier pricing, purchase details, expected delivery dates and job allocation.



3. Technician Job Coordination & Quality Follow-Up



Monitor scheduled jobs and check that technicians are completing work as per the job scope.



Review job notes, photos and completion details to ensure work has been properly documented.



Follow up technicians when information is missing, unclear or incomplete.



Check whether required photos have been uploaded before reports are prepared.



Help ensure technicians are completing jobs to company quality standards.



Assist the office team in identifying jobs that need follow-up, return visits, quoting or escalation.



Help make sure customers and property managers receive accurate updates after technical jobs.



Support technicians with job details, supplier information, parts updates and documentation requirements.



4. Time Logs, Job Tracking & Fleet Monitoring



Maintain technician time logs based on job schedules, field updates and vehicle tracking information.



Check technician start times, finish times, travel time and job completion times where required.



Assist with monitoring technician productivity and daily job progress.



Review vehicle fleet movements where required to support time log accuracy and job tracking.



Identify delays, gaps or inconsistencies between scheduled works, technician updates and actual job progress.



Help the management team understand technician workload, daily output and job completion status.



Support scheduling improvements by identifying where jobs are taking longer than expected or where routing/logistics can be improved.



5. General Operations Support



Work closely with the office team, technicians and management to keep jobs moving smoothly.



Help keep job records, reports, quotes and supplier updates organised.



Assist with internal process improvement around technical reporting, quoting, stock control and technician coordination.



Follow company templates, wording, quality standards and reporting processes.



Ask clear questions when technician notes or supplier details are incomplete.



Help maintain consistency across reports, quotes, proposals and customer communication.



Required Experience



Strong background in HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration, mechanical services, building services or HVAC operations.



Previous experience as an HVAC technician, refrigeration technician, HVAC service coordinator, HVAC admin support, dispatcher, estimator, technical report writer, maintenance coordinator, parts coordinator or similar.



Strong understanding of split systems and ducted air conditioning systems.



Ability to understand common AC faults and explain them professionally.



Ability to read technician notes and photos and turn them into clear customer-facing reports.



Experience dealing with suppliers, checking parts availability or coordinating equipment orders.



Strong written and spoken English.



High attention to detail.



Ability to work independently without needing constant supervision.



Good computer skills and ability to work with online systems, cloud documents, CRM software, job management tools and spreadsheets.



Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment.



Highly Valued Skills



Experience working with an Australian, New Zealand, UK, US or similar HVAC company.



Knowledge of Australian air conditioning terminology, supplier processes and customer expectations.



Experience preparing quotes, diagnosis reports, maintenance reports, repair proposals or insurance-style reports.



Experience coordinating technicians, job schedules, parts, stock, deliveries or supplier orders.



Understanding of property management workflows.



Knowledge of HVAC hygiene, mould contamination, coil cleaning, ducted systems, air movement and indoor air quality.



Ability to use AI tools carefully to improve writing while still applying real HVAC knowledge.



Experience with ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus, FieldPulse, Jobber, ServiceTitan, 
, CRMs, Google Workspace or similar systems.



Technical Knowledge We Are Looking For



You should be comfortable understanding and writing about:



Split system indoor and outdoor units

Ducted air conditioning systems

Evaporator coils and condenser coils

Blocked drains and drain pumps

Refrigerant leaks and pressure-related concerns

Compressor faults

Outdoor PCB faults

Indoor PCB faults

Fan motor faults

Thermistors and sensors

Capacitors

Zone motors and dampers

Airflow issues

Dirty filters and poor maintenance

Mould and microbial contamination inside AC systems

Condensation leaks

System age and replacement recommendations

Parts availability and repair feasibility

Electrical isolation and safety considerations

Preventative maintenance recommendations

Repair versus replacement recommendations



You do not need to physically diagnose systems yourself, but you must understand enough HVAC terminology and service logic to support the field team properly.



Who This Role Is Not For



Please do not apply if you are only a general virtual assistant with no HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services experience.



Please do not apply if you cannot understand technical job notes.



Please do not apply if you are uncomfortable calling suppliers or following up technicians.



Please do not apply if you rely only on AI to write technical reports without understanding the HVAC issue.



Please do not apply if you need to be told every small step throughout the day.



We need someone who is technically capable, organised, reliable, detail-focused and able to think.



Working Style



Remote work from home.



You will be working with an Australian company, so strong communication and reliability are essential.



Australian business hours are required.



You must be comfortable making phone calls to suppliers when required.



You must be comfortable asking technicians clear questions when information is missing.



You must be able to follow company templates, reporting standards and tone of voice.



You must be able to prepare reports and quotes that sound professional, trustworthy and technically sound.



You must care about accuracy. These reports and quotes are sent to real customers, property managers, landlords and commercial clients.



Example Tasks



Prepare a diagnosis report from technician notes and photos.



Prepare a repair quote after a technician identifies a suspected faulty fan motor, PCB, sensor, drain issue or compressor-related concern.



Call a supplier to check price and availability for a replacement PCB or fan motor.



Arrange delivery or pick-up of a new air conditioning system for an installation job.



Follow up a technician because job photos or fault notes are incomplete.



Check whether a technician completed all scheduled works for the day.



Review vehicle tracking and job times to help maintain technician time logs.



Prepare a recommendation explaining why an older system may not be economical to repair.



Prepare a ducted system maintenance proposal for a property manager.



Prepare a split AC hygiene report showing contamination, cleaning work completed and future maintenance recommendations.



Prepare a commercial client proposal for scheduled maintenance or hygiene works.



Update the office team about supplier delays, parts availability or technician job progress.



Personal Qualities We Want



Technically minded

Excellent written and spoken English

Confident calling suppliers

Organised and structured

Honest and reliable

Fast learner

Strong attention to detail

Self-motivated

Calm under pressure

Able to work with minimal supervision

Good at following up people politely but firmly

Proud of producing high-quality work

Comfortable working in a growing business where systems continue to improve



Training



We will provide training on our company templates, service categories, reporting style, quote structure, supplier processes, technician workflows and internal systems.



However, we are specifically looking for someone who already has real HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services knowledge. We can train you on our systems, but we cannot train a complete beginner from scratch for this role.



Compensation



Competitive monthly salary based on experience, HVAC knowledge, English quality, supplier coordination ability and overall operations experience.



There is long-term growth potential for the right person as our company expands into more HVAC services, commercial maintenance, property management work, mould remediation, restoration and technical proposal work.



How to Apply



Please send your application with the following:



Your HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services experience.

Your experience preparing reports, quotes, proposals or technical documentation.

Your experience calling suppliers, sourcing parts, arranging deliveries or coordinating technicians.

The types of AC systems you understand best.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your internet speed and available working hours.

Your experience with job management systems, CRMs, Google Workspace or spreadsheets.

A short explanation of why you would be suitable for this role.



Applications that do not mention HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration, supplier coordination or technical operations experience will not be prioritised.



Screening Questions



Please answer these questions in your application:



What is your experience with HVAC, air conditioning or refrigeration?

Have you worked with an Australian, New Zealand, UK, US or similar trade/service company before?

What is the difference between a split system and a ducted air conditioning system?

What are common reasons an AC system may leak water indoors?

What does a PCB do in an air conditioning system?

What parts would you commonly need to source for an AC repair job?

Have you called suppliers before to check parts, pricing or stock availability?

Have you coordinated technicians, job schedules, deliveries or stock pick-ups before?

Are you comfortable following up technicians if job notes or photos are incomplete?

Are you comfortable maintaining technician time logs and checking job progress?

If a system is old and repair parts are expensive or hard to source, how would you explain the repair-versus-replacement recommendation to a customer?

Have you prepared service reports, diagnosis reports, maintenance proposals or repair quotes before?

Are you available to work during Australian business hours?

Trial Task



Shortlisted applicants may be given a small test task where we provide sample technician notes, job photos and supplier information. You may be asked to prepare a short HVAC diagnosis report, quote recommendation and supplier follow-up summary.



We are looking for someone long-term who can become a key technical operations support person in our business.

title: ClickUp Project Manager (Websites and SEO)
description:
# Full-Time Project Manager for Web Design and SEO Agency



## About Frisco Web Agency



Frisco Web Agency is a growing web design and digital marketing agency based in Frisco, Texas. Our primary service is designing and developing custom websites for service-based businesses. We also manage ongoing Search Engine Optimization campaigns and occasionally take on other digital projects.



We are currently a small team of three:



* Christopher Potter — Owner

* Rocky Diana — Web Developer

* Melissa Saldana — Administrative Support



We are looking for a full-time Project Manager who can take ownership of our client projects, organize our fulfillment process, and keep everything moving forward without requiring constant direction.



## The Main Outcome of This Role



The most important responsibility of this position is simple:



**Make sure every project continues moving forward and is completed on time—or preferably ahead of schedule.**



As the owner, Christopher needs to focus more of his time on marketing, sales, strategy, and growing the company. Right now, managing multiple active projects can pull him away from those responsibilities.



Your role will be to take ownership of the day-to-day management of our fulfillment.



You will need to know:



* Where every project currently stands

* What has already been completed

* What still needs to be completed

* Who is responsible for each task

* What is due next

* What is falling behind

* What information we are waiting on

* What the client needs to know

* What could prevent us fro
eting a deadline



We do not want someone who only updates tasks after being told what to do. We need someone who thinks ahead, identifies problems early, communicates clearly, and actively pushes projects toward completion every day.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Manage Website Projects



Most of your work will involve managing custom website design and development projects.



You will be responsible for:



* Setting up and organizing projects in ClickUp

* Reviewing each active project every day

* Creating and assigning tasks

* Confirming that tasks have clear descriptions, deadlines, and owners

* Following up with tea
mbers about incomplete or overdue work

* Identifying the next steps before the current steps are completed

* Coordinating design, content, development, revisions, quality assurance, and launch

* Gathering missing information and materials from clients

* Communicating project updates to clients

* Preventing projects from becoming stalled

* Keeping projects on schedule and pushing for early completion

* Escalating problems before they become emergencies



### Manage SEO Campaigns



Website projects will be the primary responsibility, but you will also help manage ongoing SEO campaigns.



This may include:



* Organizing monthly SEO deliverables in ClickUp

* Confirming that assigned SEO work is completed

* Coordinating content, website updates, keyword research, on-page optimization, and reporting

* Tracking recurring monthly responsibilities

* Preparing client updates

* Following up on missing approvals or information

* Making sure monthly deliverables do not get overlooked



You do not need to be an advanced SEO strategist, but you should be willing to learn our process and understand enough to manage the work effectively.



### Communicate With Clients



You will become one of the main points of contact for active client projects.



Communication may take place through:



*

* ClickUp

* Google Meet

* Internal tea
ssages



You will be responsible for:



* Providing clear and proactive updates

* Asking clients for missing content, feedback, approvals, or access

* Explaining what is happening next

* Following up when a client has not responded

* Setting realistic expectations

* Keeping communication professional, organized, and easy to understand

* Making sure clients do not have to ask us repeatedly for updates



Clients should feel that their project is organized, actively managed, and moving forward.



### Communicate With the Team



You will communicate with our team throughout the workday, Monday through Friday.



This includes:



* Reviewing progress with tea
mbers

* Following up on tasks

* Answering project-related questions

* Clarifying priorities

* Identifying blockers

* Confirming deadlines

* Making sure tea
mbers understand what is expected

* Communicating important client feedback

* Helping the team determine what should be worked on next



You must be comfortable holding people accountable respectfully and directly.



### Own and Improve ClickUp



ClickUp is the primary project management system used by Frisco Web Agency.



You will be expected to:



* Keep ClickUp accurate and up to date

* Make sure tasks are assigned correctly

* Maintain deadlines, statuses, dependencies, and priorities

* Ensure task descriptions contain enough information for the work to be completed

* Keep client and internal communication organized

* Improve dashboards, templates, automations, and workflows

* Identify areas where ClickUp is becoming confusing or inefficient

* Recommend and implement improvements

* Make ClickUp a reliable source of truth for the entire company



At any time, we should be able to open ClickUp and quickly understand the status of every project.



### Maintain Company Playbooks



We use the Buy Back Your Time playbook method to document how work should be completed.



You will help:



* Create playbooks for repeatable processes

* Update playbooks when our processes change

* Organize instructions, videos, links, and resources

* Identify missing documentation

* Make sure tea
mbers follow the documented process

* Improve processes based on problems that occur during fulfillment



Our goal is to build a company that does not depend on information being stored only in one person’s head.



## What We Are Looking For



The right person for this role is:



* Highly organized

* Proactive

* Dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable following up with people

* Able to communicate professionally with clients

* Able to manage several projects at the same time

* Calm when priorities change

* Willing to take ownership of outcomes

* Able to think several steps ahead

* Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Able to make decisions without needing constant approval

* Interested in improving systems and processes

* Consistent with communication

* Able to identify potential delays before deadlines are missed



You should naturally notice when something has not been completed and take action without waiting to be reminded.



## This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You:



* Wait for someone to tell you every next step

* Avoid difficult conversations or follow-ups

* Regularly forget details

* Are uncomfortable holding others accountable

* Only update ClickUp when someone reminds you

* Become overwhelmed when managing several projects

* Disappear during your working hours

* Allow unanswered questions to sit unresolved

* Assume that someone else will take responsibility

* Communicate vaguely or leave people uncertain

* Prefer completing isolated tasks instead of owning the overall outcome



## Required Qualifications



* Previous experience in project management, operations, or client coordination

* Experience using ClickUp or a similar project management platform

* Strong written and spoken English

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Experience communicating with clients through
 and meetings

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects

* Ability to document and improve processes

* Willingness to learn website development and SEO fulfillment processes



Experience working for a web design, marketing, SEO, or digital agency is strongly preferred.



## Working Hours and Availability



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday.



You must be available for a daily meeting with Christopher at:



**8:00 a.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday**



Because this is a communication-heavy role, you must also be responsive and available during your agreed working hours. Your working schedule will be established so that you have enough overlap with Christopher, the team, and our clients.



This is not a position where you can complete all your work without communicating with the team. Active communication throughout the workweek is an essential part of the job.



## Trial Period and Payment



This position will begin with a 90-day trial period.



During the trial period, we will evaluate:



* Reliability

* Communication

* Organization

* Ownership

* Ability to manage deadlines

* ClickUp management

* Client communication

* Team coordination

* Ability to keep projects moving

* Overall fit with the company



You will be paid every two weeks. You will complete each two-week work period and then receive payment for that completed period.



**Starting compensation: [INSERT MONTHLY SALARY OR HOURLY RATE]**



There is room for increased responsibility, compensation, and long-term growth as Frisco Web Agency grows.



## What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role when:



* Christopher no longer has to personally manage every project

* Every project has a clear status, owner, deadline, and next step

* Tea
mbers know what they should be working on

* Clients receive proactive communication

* Delays are identified and addressed early

* ClickUp is consistently accurate

* Tasks do not disappear or remain forgotten

* Projects are completed on time or ahead of schedule

* Company processes are documented and continuously improved

* You can clearly explain the status of every active project without confusion or uncertainty



The long-term goal is for you to fully own project fulfillment so Christopher can focus on marketing, sales, leadership, and growing the business.



## How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous project management experience

3. Your experience using ClickUp

4. Any experience managing website or SEO projects

5. An example of a project that was falling behind and how you moved it forward

6. Your approach to following up with a tea
mber who repeatedly misses deadlines

7. Your internet speed and computer specifications

8. Confirmation that you can attend a daily meeting at 8:00 a.m. Central Time

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. A short video introduction explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position



At the beginning of your application, include the words:



**“I push projects forward.”**



Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

We are currently supporting several private equity-backed and multi-entity organizations that are migrating from QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online to Sage Intacct and are looking for an experienced consultant to support these projects.

title: Remote Operations VA - US Car Rental (Phone, GoHighLevel, Clear English a MUST)
description:
About us:

Odel Rentals is a U.S.-based car rental company in Maryland. We rent cars to gig drivers (Uber, DoorDash, Instacart, Amazon Flex) and to direct renters. We run on GoHighLevel (GHL) and we use an AI assistant to help run the business. We are a small, fast-moving team that values clear communication, discipline, and real ownership. Do great work here and you grow with us.



What you will do:

You are the main person talking to our U.S. renters and keeping the operation organized. This is a phone-first job. You must be comfortable calling people, sounding warm and professional, and helping renters on the phone.

- Call new leads fast, answer inbound calls, explain our service, and qualify renters.

- Collect and review renter documents (driver's license, gig-earnings screenshot, proof of residency) and spot anything fake, expired, or mismatched.

- Run background checks and judge them. Auto-fail theft, violence, or fraud history. Escalate when unsure.

- Coordinate pickups and returns. No car is released without confirmed payment AND a signed agreement.

- Help manage our AI dashboard: it writes draft messages for you to check, and you catch the bad ones before they go out.

- Keep our GoHighLevel CRM clean: work leads, move them through the pipeline, log every call and note, run follow-ups.

- Track payments, send reminders, update our fleet and revenue sheets, and store documents where they belong.



Must-haves (read carefully):

1. CLEAR, NEUTRAL SPOKEN ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. This is a phone job with U.S. customers. You must be easy for an American to understand on the first try. This is our number one requirement, no exceptions.

2. Strong written English.

3. Comfortable on the phone. You can call people and not get rattled.

4. Sharp eye for risky renters and fake documents.

5. Detail-obsessed and reliable. You log everything and follow a written process exactly.

6. CRM experience. GoHighLevel (GHL) strongly preferred. If you are strong on the phone and have used another CRM, we will train you on GHL.

7. You can reliably work U.S. Eastern daytime hours (your night) long-term.

8. Good internet, a working headset, a quiet place to take calls, and a backup for power or wifi outages.



Nice-to-haves:

- Bilingual English/Spanish (many gig drivers are Spanish-first).

- Hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- U.S. car rental, Turo, or transportation experience.

- Spreadsheets and background-check tools (Intelius, Forewarn). Comfort with AI tools.



Hours and pay: Full-time, U.S. Eastern Time daytime, the same full hours every day, long-term. This role pays up to $5 per hour (about $500 to $866 per month), based on your experience. Only apply if that works for you. You start on a smaller set of tasks (lead response, phone calls, helping manage our AI dashboard) and take on more as you prove out.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly or you will be skipped):

Do NOT send a generic copy-paste reply. In your application, answer ALL of these questions in order. To prove you read this whole post, work the words "FULL TANK" into one of your answers in a full sentence (not just the words by themselves). Applications that skip the questions or leave out "FULL TANK" will not be reviewed.

1. Have you worked in a role where you handled structured processes and strict deadlines? Give an example.

2. How comfortable are you making phone calls daily with U.S. customers? About how many calls per day have you done, and what kind?

3. What experience do you have specifically with GoHighLevel (GHL)? If you have used it, describe exactly what you did in it. If not, what other CRM have you used?

4. What U.S. hours can you reliably work long-term, and can you keep a U.S. Eastern daytime schedule (your night)?

5. Where did you learn English, and can a U.S. customer easily understand you on the phone? Be honest.

6. Have you ever reviewed ID documents, run background checks, or screened customers? Describe it.

7. Scenario: a renter wants to take the car tonight but has not paid yet and has not signed the agreement. What do you do?

8. What is your expected pay (per hour or per month)? This role pays up to $5 per hour, so only apply if that works for you.



Plus a 60 to 90 second Loom or video recording where you introduce yourself in English and read this line out loud in a natural voice: "Hi, thanks for calling Odel Rentals, are you currently a gig driver and how long are you looking to rent?" Paste the link in your application. No video means we will not review it. This is how we hear your phone voice.
